entries.en: A `category` parameter has been added to policy groups for grouped display. It can be used when there are many policy groups.
entries.zh: 策略组新增 `category` 参数，用于分组展示。策略组很多时可用。

entries.en: Added support for the Surge Language Support extension for VS Code, providing syntax highlighting and real-time diagnostics for profiles, modules, and rule sets. Includes automatic file detection and validation of policy references in detached configurations when the main profile is open.
entries.zh: 新增对 VS Code 的 Surge Language Support 扩展的支持：为 profile、模块和规则集提供语法高亮与实时诊断；主 profile 打开时还会自动检测拆分配置，并校验其中的策略引用。

entries.en: This extension relies on the Surge application package and requires Surge Mac 6.10.0 or later. Its profile parsing capabilities are automatically updated when Surge is upgraded.
entries.zh: 该扩展依赖本机的 Surge App 包做解析，要求 Surge Mac 6.10.0 或更高版本；Surge 升级后，扩展的 profile 解析能力会自动跟随更新。

entries.en: Add a workaround for a system bug in macOS 27.2 beta to prevent Dashboard from crashing.
entries.zh: 针对 macOS 27.2 beta 的系统 bug 加了规避措施，避免 Dashboard 崩溃。

entries.en: Added UNKNOWN support to GEOIP and IP-ASN rules, allowing you to match destination IP addresses with no corresponding country or ASN database entry. Supported in both individual rules and rule sets.
entries.zh: `GEOIP` 与 `IP-ASN` 规则新增 `UNKNOWN` 取值，用于匹配在国家 / ASN 数据库里查不到对应记录的目标 IP。单条规则与规则集都支持。

entries.en: All `test-url` parameters now support configuring HTTPS URLs for testing. The test result remains the latency of a single HTTP RTT, but due to the TLS handshake, the test duration may increase significantly when there are many policies.
entries.zh: 所有 `test-url` 参数现在都支持 HTTPS 测试地址。结果仍表示单次 HTTP 往返（RTT）的延迟；TLS 握手会增加测试总耗时，策略数量较多时尤为明显。

entries.en: Fixed Hysteria UDP traffic failing with servers where HTTP/3 Datagram negotiation interfered with UDP forwarding.
entries.zh: 修复：当服务端的 HTTP/3 Datagram 协商干扰 UDP 转发时，Hysteria 的 UDP 流量失败。

entries.en: Fixed a rare issue where a UDP proxy connection closing during packet reception could stall other traffic handled by Surge.
entries.zh: 修复：极少数情况下，UDP 代理连接在收包期间关闭会拖住 Surge 处理的其它流量。

entries.en: Fixed dark menu text becoming unreadable on macOS 26 and improved menu bar icon colors when the system appearance changes.
entries.zh: 修复：macOS 26 上深色模式菜单文字不可读；并改善了系统外观切换时菜单栏图标的配色。

entries.en: Fixed logical rules incorrectly parsing policy names containing parentheses.
entries.zh: 修复：逻辑规则无法正确解析含括号的策略名。

entries.en: Fixed macOS Smart policy group context menus showing outdated usage or incorrect priority adjustments.
entries.zh: 修复：macOS 上 Smart 策略组的右键菜单显示了过期的使用情况或错误的优先级调整。

entries.en: Fixed missing traffic statistics for UDP connections through proxies and tunnels, including WireGuard and Tailscale.
entries.zh: 修复：经由代理与隧道（含 WireGuard、Tailscale）的 UDP 连接缺失流量统计。

entries.en: Fixed unnecessary Surge Helper installation or upgrade alerts at startup when the enabled features do not require the helper.
entries.zh: 修复：已启用的功能并不需要 Surge Helper 时，启动仍弹出安装 / 升级提示。

entries.en: Improved UDP test diagnostics for peer-to-peer Tailscale and WireGuard policies without Internet egress, reporting unsupported tests instead of waiting for a timeout.
entries.zh: 改进：对没有互联网出口的点对点 Tailscale / WireGuard 策略，UDP 测试会直接报告不支持，避免一直等待至超时。

entries.en: In the previous version, MITM security was strengthened by generating a separate key pair for each distinct domain name. This caused noticeable delays when performing MITM concurrently on a large number of different domains. After evaluation, this change has been reverted.
entries.zh: 上一版为加强 MITM 安全性，为每个不同域名各生成一对密钥。这导致同时对大量不同域名做 MITM 时出现明显延迟。经评估后**该项改动已回退**。

entries.en: Inline rule sets with the same name now merge across the main profile and modules instead of replacing one another, preserving rules contributed by each source.
entries.zh: 同名内联规则集现在会在主配置与模块之间**合并**，而不再互相覆盖 —— 每个来源贡献的规则都会保留。

entries.en: The macOS logical rule editor now supports Pre-Matching for AND, OR, and NOT rules using a reject policy, and identifies unsupported sub-rules before saving.
entries.zh: macOS 逻辑规则编辑器现已支持对 AND、OR 和 NOT 规则使用拒绝策略进行预匹配，并在保存前识别不受支持的子规则。

entries.en: Added `block-quic=adaptive` for proxy policies. Surge blocks QUIC at first so the app falls back to HTTPS over TCP. If the app does not fall back within 1 second, as with apps that only support QUIC, QUIC is allowed for that host. Results are remembered per host. The option is also available in the proxy editor on Mac and iOS.
entries.zh: 为代理策略添加了 `block-quic=adaptive`。Surge 最初会阻止 QUIC，从而使应用程序回退到基于 TCP 的 HTTPS。如果应用程序未能在 1 秒内回退（例如仅支持 QUIC 的应用程序），则允许该主机使用 QUIC。结果会按主机缓存。此选项在 Mac 和 iOS 上的代理编辑器中也可用。

entries.en: Added a `category` parameter to policy groups for grouped display, useful when there are many policy groups.
entries.zh: 为策略组添加了 `category` 参数，用于分组显示，在策略组数量较多时非常有用。

entries.en: Fixed a scripting-engine compatibility issue.

entries.en: Improved Tailscale and WireGuard behavior when switching networks.
entries.zh: 改进了在网络间切换时 Tailscale 和 WireGuard 的行为。

entries.en: Improved performance and memory usage, fixed rare crashes, and resolved other minor issues.
entries.zh: 改进了性能和内存使用情况，修复了罕见的崩溃问题，并解决了其他一些小问题。

entries.en: Improved the Add Rule page: domain rules can now be created from SNI-sniffed requests, and rule-specific options can be selected directly.
entries.zh: 改进“添加规则”页面：现在可根据 SNI 嗅探的请求创建域名规则，并直接选择相应规则的专用选项。

entries.en: Inline rule sets with the same name now merge across the main profile and modules instead of replacing one another, preserving the rules contributed by each source.
entries.zh: 名称相同的内联规则集现在会在主配置文件和模块之间合并，而不是相互替换，从而保留每个来源贡献的规则。

entries.en: QUIC hostname detection now works when the TLS ClientHello spans several packets, which is common in recent browsers using post-quantum key exchange. QUIC v2 and draft-29 are now supported as well. Rules, MITM and request records can now see the hostname of more QUIC connections.
entries.zh: QUIC 主机名识别现在支持跨多个数据包的 TLS ClientHello；采用后量子密钥交换的新浏览器常见这种情况。同时支持 QUIC v2 和 draft-29。规则、MITM 与请求记录现在能识别更多 QUIC 连接的主机名。

entries.en: Removed an erroneous Ponte notification when using a Ponte policy in a policy group.
entries.zh: 移除了在使用策略组中的 Ponte 策略时出现的错误 Ponte 通知。

entries.en: The previous version strengthened MITM security by generating a separate key pair for each distinct domain, which caused noticeable delays when intercepting many different domains concurrently. After evaluation, this change has been reverted.
entries.zh: 之前的版本通过为每个不同域名生成独立密钥对来加强了 MITM 安全性，但这导致在同时拦截多个不同域名时出现了明显的延迟。经过评估，此更改已被撤销。

entries.en: Updated UI layouts and details for iPhone Duo support. (iOS)
entries.zh: 更新了 iPhone Duo 支持的 UI 布局和细节。(iOS)

entries.en: We’re pleased to announce that Surge Mac 6.10.0, Surge iOS 5.23.0, and Surge tvOS 5.23.0 are now available.
entries.zh: 我们很高兴地宣布，Surge Mac 6.10.0、Surge iOS 5.23.0 和 Surge tvOS 5.23.0 现已发布。

entries.en: `GET /v1/policies` of the HTTP API now accepts the `include_external=true` query parameter. The response then contains an additional `external-policies` field that lists the policies loaded from external policy groups (`policy-path`). Each entry includes the policy name, the group it belongs to, and an identifier. Pass the identifier as the `policy` option of `$httpClient` to send a request through that policy, since external policies cannot be referenced by name.
entries.zh: HTTP API 的 `GET /v1/policies` 现在接受 `include_external=true` 查询参数。响应中将包含一个额外的 `external-policies` 字段，用于列出从外部策略组 (`policy-path`) 加载的策略。每个条目都包含策略名称、所属策略组以及一个标识符。由于外部策略无法通过名称引用，因此请将此标识符作为 `$httpClient` 的 `policy` 选项传递，以便通过该策略发送请求。

entries.en: `block-quic=auto` now uses adaptive mode for every policy except DIRECT, so QUIC-only apps keep working through proxies. Policies that cannot relay UDP still block QUIC.
entries.zh: `block-quic=auto` 现在对除 DIRECT 外的所有策略采用自适应模式，使仅支持 QUIC 的应用仍能通过代理工作。无法转发 UDP 的策略仍会阻断 QUIC。

entries.en: Clients can set Surge's tunnel address as their DNS server, and Surge's DNS will answer their queries.
entries.zh: 客户端可以将 Surge 的隧道地址设置为自己的 DNS 服务器，Surge 的 DNS 将响应其查询。

entries.en: Exit nodes and subnet routes take effect after you approve them in the Tailscale admin console.
entries.zh: 退出节点和子网路由在您于 Tailscale 管理控制台中批准后生效。

entries.en: Fixed an issue where an `external` policy used directly as the `underlying-proxy` of another policy did not start its process automatically. The process only started after a latency test.
entries.zh: 修复了一个问题：当 `external` 策略被直接用作另一策略的 `underlying-proxy` 时，其进程不会自动启动。只有在执行延迟测试后，该进程才会启动。

entries.en: Incoming Connections for Tailscale and WireGuard
entries.zh: Tailscale 和 WireGuard 的入站连接

entries.en: Note: Surge does not apply your Tailscale access control policy to incoming connections. Use rules such as `SRC-IP` to limit who can reach which destination.
entries.zh: 注意：Surge 不会将您的 Tailscale 访问控制策略应用于入站连接。请使用 `SRC-IP` 等规则来限制谁可以访问哪些目标。

entries.en: Requires iOS 5.24.0+ / Mac 6.11.0+. See the Tailscale and WireGuard pages in the manual for details and example configurations.
entries.zh: 需要 iOS 5.24.0+ / Mac 6.11.0+. 有关详细信息和示例配置，请参阅手册中的 Tailscale 和 WireGuard 页面。

entries.en: Surge can now accept connections that come in through Tailscale and WireGuard, not just send traffic out. Incoming requests are handled like any other request: they go through your rules and policies and show up in the request list.
entries.zh: 现在，Surge 不仅可以发送出站流量，还可以接受通过 Tailscale 和 WireGuard 传入的连接。入站请求的处理方式与其他请求相同：它们会经过您的规则集和策略组，并显示在请求列表中。

entries.en: `accept-incoming = true`: other devices on your tailnet can connect to this device through its tailnet address. For example, they can use Surge's HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy or other services running on this device.
entries.zh: `accept-incoming = true`: 您 tailnet 网络中的其他设备可以通过该设备的 tailnet 地址连接到此设备。例如，它们可以使用 Surge 的 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理或运行在此设备上的其他服务。

entries.en: `accept-incoming = true`: the peer side can open connections to this device through an existing tunnel.
entries.zh: `accept-incoming = true`: 对端可以通过现有隧道与此设备建立连接。

entries.en: `advertise-exit-node = true`: offer this device as an exit node. Other tailnet devices that select it send all their internet traffic through Surge's rules.
entries.zh: `advertise-exit-node = true`: 将此设备提供为出口节点。选择它的其他 tailnet 设备会通过 Surge 的规则发送其所有互联网流量。

entries.en: `advertise-routes = 192.168.1.0/24, ...`: offer this device as a subnet router for the listed networks.
entries.zh: `advertise-routes = 192.168.1.0/24, ...`: 将此设备作为所列网络的子网路由器提供。

entries.en: `listen-port = 51820`: Surge acts as a WireGuard server that phones, laptops, and other clients can connect to. A peer can leave out `endpoint`; Surge learns the client's address when it connects and keeps up when the address changes.
entries.zh: `listen-port = 51820`: Surge 充当 WireGuard 服务器，手机、笔记本电脑和其他客户端都可以连接到它。对等方可以省略 `endpoint`; Surge 会在客户端连接时获知其地址，并在地址变更时保持同步。

entries.en: `allow-peer-access = true`: other devices on your tailnet can connect to this device through its tailnet address. For example, they can use Surge's HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy or other services running on this device.
entries.zh: `allow-peer-access = true`: 您 tailnet 网络中的其他设备可以通过该设备的 tailnet 地址连接到此设备。例如，它们可以使用 Surge 的 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理或运行在此设备上的其他服务。

entries.en: `allow-peer-access = true`: the peer side can open connections to this device through an existing tunnel.
entries.zh: `allow-peer-access = true`: 对端可以通过现有隧道与此设备建立连接。

entries.en: A policy group page. You can select policies, override auto groups, run latency tests and see smart group usage. Group icons set with `icon-url` show the same way as on iOS.
entries.zh: 策略组页面。你可以选择策略、覆盖自动组、运行延迟测试并查看 Smart Group 使用情况。使用 `icon-url` 设置的组图标会采用与 iOS 相同的显示方式。

entries.en: Adaptive QUIC Block: detection now starts only on new QUIC handshakes. Before, packets from QUIC connections that already existed (for example, ones opened before Surge started) could be wrongly remembered as allowed. They are now blocked so that the app starts a new handshake.
entries.zh: 自适应 QUIC 阻断：现在只从新的 QUIC 握手开始检测。此前，已经存在的 QUIC 连接（例如 Surge 启动前建立的连接）发来的数据包可能被错误地记为已允许。现在会阻断这些数据包，使应用重新发起新的握手。

entries.en: An external resource page. You can update resources one at a time or all at once.
entries.zh: 外部资源页面。你可以逐个更新资源，也可以一次全部更新。

entries.en: An outbound mode button. Its menu also turns MitM, Rewrite and Scripting on or off.
entries.zh: 出站模式按钮。其菜单还可开启或关闭 MitM、Rewrite 与 Scripting。

entries.en: DTLS, WireGuard, STUN and other non-QUIC UDP traffic on port 443 is no longer treated as QUIC, so `block-quic` no longer affects it.
entries.zh: 端口 443 上的 DTLS、WireGuard、STUN 及其他非 QUIC 的 UDP 流量将不再被视为 QUIC，因此 `block-quic` 不再对其生效。

entries.en: Fixed requests failing with 503 when a server sends a body after a 304 or another response that should have no body (for example, ASUSWRT-Merlin routers).
entries.zh: 修复了服务器在 304 或其他本应无响应体的响应后仍发送 body 时，请求返回 503 的问题（例如 ASUSWRT-Merlin 路由器）。

entries.en: Fixed the issue where incoming UDP packets could not be forwarded when the destination address is the local machine.
entries.zh: 修复了目标地址为本机时，入站 UDP 数据包无法转发的问题。

entries.en: Please check: https://kb.nssurge.com/surge-knowledge-base/release-notes/snell
entries.zh: 请检查：https://kb.nssurge.com/surge-knowledge-base/release-notes/snell

entries.en: Please note that before using the new tvOS version, you need to redeploy using the latest Surge iOS TestFlight version, otherwise it cannot be enabled.
entries.zh: 请注意，使用新版 tvOS 版本前，需要先通过最新版 Surge iOS TestFlight 重新部署，否则无法启用。

entries.en: Please note that due to its unusual communication mechanism, Apple Screen Sharing's high-performance mode cannot be used even if `allow-peer-access` is enabled. We are looking into a dedicated workaround for this.
entries.zh: 请注意，由于其通信机制特殊，即使启用了 `allow-peer-access`，也无法使用 Apple Screen Sharing 的高性能模式。我们正在研究专门的解决方案。

entries.en: Ponte: a device no longer stays stuck in "LAN-only mode" when its record was captured while its remote channels were restarting. Surge refreshes the device list before giving up, and the error message now explains why.
entries.zh: Ponte：当设备在远程通道重启期间捕获了其记录后，该设备不会再卡在“仅 LAN 模式”中。Surge 在放弃前会刷新设备列表，并且错误消息现在会解释其原因。

entries.en: Resolved the issue of needing to repeatedly reactivate when using multiple users or multiple operating systems on the same device. For details, please refer to the knowledge base licensing FAQ to learn about the corresponding methods.
entries.zh: 解决了在同一设备上使用多个用户或多个操作系统时需要反复激活的问题。有关具体方法，请参阅知识库的授权 FAQ。

entries.en: Ruleset Editor
entries.zh: 规则集编辑器

entries.en: Snell 6.0.0
entries.zh: Snell 6.0.0 版本

entries.en: Snell 6.0.0 RC2 has been released as the final 6.0.0 version, and the download links have been updated. Additionally, a macOS arm64 binary has been added.
entries.zh: Snell 6.0.0 RC2 已作为最终 6.0.0 版本发布，下载链接也已更新。此外新增了 macOS arm64 二进制。

entries.en: Snell v6: UDP data is now sent right after the tunnel command, without waiting a round trip for the server's response. QUIC over Snell v6 connects noticeably faster. This requires a v6 server.
entries.zh: Snell v6：UDP 数据现在会在隧道命令后立即发送，无需等待服务器响应的一次往返。通过 Snell v6 建立 QUIC 连接的速度会明显更快；这需要 v6 服务器。

entries.en: Surge tvOS Beta
entries.zh: Surge tvOS Beta 测试版

entries.en: The old parameter `accept-incoming` has been renamed to `allow-peer-access`, but it will still be read for compatibility.
entries.zh: 旧参数 `accept-incoming` 已重命名为 `allow-peer-access`，但为了兼容仍会读取该旧参数。

entries.en: When a SOCKS5 proxy rejects a connection, Surge now shows the reason the server gave (such as connection refused or host unreachable) instead of an "invalid response" error.
entries.zh: 当 SOCKS5 代理拒绝连接时，Surge 现在会显示服务器给出的原因（例如 connection refused 或 host unreachable），不再只显示“invalid response”错误。

entries.en: You can now control Surge tvOS directly on the Apple TV. While Surge is running, the start screen has a new column with:
entries.zh: 现在可以直接在 Apple TV 上控制 Surge tvOS。Surge 运行时，启动界面新增一列，包含：

entries.en: You can now disable individual rules in a ruleset with the Enable/Disable swipe action. Disabled rules are saved as commented-out lines.
entries.zh: 现在，您可以通过“启用/停用”滑动操作来停用规则集中的单个规则。停用的规则将以注释行的形式保存。

entries.en: [Mac] Resolved the issue of needing to repeatedly reactivate when using multiple users or multiple operating systems on the same device. For details, please refer to the knowledge base licensing FAQ to learn about the corresponding methods.
entries.zh: [Mac] 解决了在同一设备上使用多个用户或多个操作系统时需要反复激活的问题。有关具体方法，请参阅知识库的授权 FAQ。

entries.en: [iOS] Fixed a possible network extension crash when viewing the Logbook with very large script records.
entries.zh: [iOS] 修复了日志中脚本记录很大时查看 Logbook 可能导致网络扩展崩溃的问题。

entries.en: [iOS] Fixed high memory use on MITM HTTP/2 connections when the client reads slowly. This could push the network extension past its memory limit.
entries.zh: [iOS] 修复了客户端读取较慢时 MITM HTTP/2 连接占用内存过高的问题；此前可能使网络扩展超过内存上限。

entries.en: [iOS] Fixed text fields in sheets being covered by the keyboard in some sheet sizes, and the space left for the keyboard not always being removed after it was dismissed.
entries.zh: [iOS] 修复了部分弹窗尺寸下文本框被键盘遮挡，以及键盘收起后为键盘预留的空间有时没有移除的问题。

entries.en: [iOS] Fixed the external resource view sometimes being presented twice.
entries.zh: [iOS] 修复了外部资源视图有时重复弹出的问题。

entries.en: [iOS] Optimized the keyboard layout for iPhone Duo.
entries.zh: [iOS] 优化了 iPhone Duo 的键盘布局。

entries.en: `allow-peer-access = true`: other devices on your tailnet can connect to this device through its tailnet address. For example, they can use Surge's HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy or other services running on this device. (The old parameter `accept-incoming` has been renamed, but it will still be read for compatibility.)
entries.zh: `allow-peer-access = true`：Tailnet 中的其他设备可通过此设备的 tailnet 地址连接到它。例如，它们可以使用 Surge 的 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理或该设备上的其他服务。（旧参数 `accept-incoming` 已重命名，但为了兼容仍会读取。）

entries.en: Dashboard Issue on macOS 27.2
entries.zh: macOS 上的仪表板问题 27.2

entries.en: Details and download:
entries.zh: 详细信息和下载：

entries.en: In the meantime:
entries.zh: 在此期间：

entries.en: Surge Mac users on macOS 27.2: you may find that Surge Dashboard quits immediately after launch. Surge itself and all network features are not affected.
entries.zh: macOS 27.2 上的 Surge Mac 用户：您可能会发现 Surge 仪表盘在启动后立即退出。Surge 本身及所有网络功能均不受影响。

entries.en: This is caused by a system issue in macOS 27.2 that can affect other apps as well. We reported it to Apple, and Apple has confirmed the fix, which will ship with the next macOS update.
entries.zh: 此问题由 macOS 27.2 中的一个系统问题引起，也可能影响其他应用程序。我们已向 Apple 报告了该问题，Apple 已确认修复方案，该修复将随下一个 macOS 更新一同发布。

entries.en: • Alternatively, you can simply wait for the next macOS update, which will resolve the issue.
entries.zh: • 或者，您也可以直接等待下一个 macOS 更新，该更新将解决此问题。

entries.en: • If your subscription has expired, we've released Surge Dashboard Patcher, a free tool that replaces only the bundled Dashboard with a fixed build. Surge and your profiles are left untouched.
entries.zh: • 如果您的订阅已过期，我们已发布 Surge Dashboard Patcher，这是一款免费工具，仅将捆绑的 Dashboard 替换为修复后的版本。Surge 和您的配置文件均不受影响。

entries.en: • If your update subscription is active, update to Surge Mac 6.10.0 or later, which already works around the issue.
entries.zh: • 如果您的更新订阅处于活动状态，请更新到 Surge Mac 6.10.0 或更高版本，该版本已对该问题进行了规避处理。

entries.en: A serious security incident involving eMudhra's Intermediate Certificate Authorities (CAs) has recently been disclosed. The compromise of CA private keys could allow attackers to issue seemingly legitimate TLS certificates for arbitrary domains, potentially enabling man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacks against HTTPS connections.
entries.zh: 最近披露了一起涉及 eMudhra 中间证书颁发机构（CA）的严重安全事件。CA 私钥遭泄露可能导致攻击者为任意域名签发看似合法的 TLS 证书，从而可能对 HTTPS 连接实施中间人（MITM）攻击。

entries.en: Fixed HTTP/2 responses with no body (304, 204, or a response to HEAD) not being handled correctly when both a response script and a body rewrite rule matched.
entries.zh: 修复了当响应脚本和正文重写规则均匹配时，HTTP/2 响应中无正文（304、204 或对 HEAD 的响应）未被正确处理的问题。

entries.en: Fixed `$surge.retestGroup` failing in scripts that use the WebView engine when no policy list was returned.
entries.zh: 修复了在未返回任何策略组列表时，使用 WebView 引擎的脚本中 `$surge.retestGroup` 失效的问题。

entries.en: Fixed pipelined HTTP/1 requests sent after a chunked request body being forwarded as part of that body instead of being handled as separate requests.
entries.zh: 修复了在分块请求体之后发送的流水线 HTTP/1 请求被作为该请求体的一部分转发，而非作为独立请求处理的问题。

entries.en: Fixed several edge cases in HTTP/1 connection reuse and closing that could mix up responses or leave connections open.
entries.zh: 修复了 HTTP/1 连接复用和关闭过程中的几个边缘情况，这些问题可能导致响应混淆或连接保持打开状态。

entries.en: HTTP proxy: the `Proxy-Authorization` header is no longer forwarded to the upstream server. It carries the credentials for Surge's own proxy.
entries.zh: HTTP 代理：`Proxy-Authorization` 标头将不再转发到上游服务器。它用于承载 Surge 自身代理的凭据。

entries.en: HTTP/2: a malformed request now resets only its own stream instead of the whole connection.
entries.zh: HTTP/2：格式错误的请求现在只会重置其自身的流，而不会重置整个连接。

entries.en: HTTP/2: when the upstream server closes the connection in the middle of a response, Surge now reports it as truncated instead of as a complete response.
entries.zh: HTTP/2：当上游服务器在响应中途关闭连接时，Surge 现在会将其报告为“截断”，而非“完整响应”。

entries.en: Major platform vendors, including Apple, Google, Microsoft, and Mozilla, have taken measures to distrust the affected CA certificates.
entries.zh: 包括 Apple、Google、Microsoft 和 Mozilla 在内的主要平台供应商已采取措施，不再信任受影响的 CA 证书。

entries.en: New `peer-access-passthrough` option for Tailscale and WireGuard policies. It is on by default when `accept-incoming` / `allow-peer-access` is enabled.- Incoming connections to this device's tunnel address are handed to the local service directly, so the service sees the peer's real address and port.
entries.zh: 为 Tailscale 和 WireGuard 策略组引入了新的 `peer-access-passthrough` 选项。当启用 `accept-incoming` / `allow-peer-access` 时，该选项默认开启。- 到此设备隧道地址的入站连接将直接交给本地服务处理，因此服务可以看到对端的真实地址和端口。

entries.en: No action is required for Surge users. Although Surge uses its own TLS protocol stack and MITM engine, it strictly relies on the operating system's certificate trust evaluation mechanisms to validate certificate chains. As a result, Surge benefits from the same certificate trust and revocation protections enforced by the operating system.
entries.zh: Surge 用户无需执行任何操作。尽管 Surge 使用其自身的 TLS 协议栈和 MITM 引擎，但它严格依赖操作系统的证书信任评估机制来验证证书链。因此，Surge 能够受益于操作系统所强制实施的相同证书信任和吊销保护。

entries.en: Peer Access Passthrough
entries.zh: 对等访问直通

entries.en: Ponte: a device is no longer wrongly treated as being on the same LAN when both sides have the same virtual machine bridge address (OrbStack, Parallels, UTM and similar).
entries.zh: Ponte：当两端具有相同的虚拟机桥接地址时（OrbStack、Parallels、UTM 及类似情况），设备不再被错误地视为处于同一局域网。

entries.en: Ponte: device records in logs no longer include the PSK or controller key.
entries.zh: Ponte：日志中的设备记录现在不再包含 PSK 或控制器密钥。

entries.en: Ponte: when a LAN connection attempt fails, Surge now falls back to Internet mode and refreshes the device record, instead of ending in a ping timeout.
entries.zh: Ponte：当 LAN 连接尝试失败时，Surge 现在会回退到 Internet 模式并刷新设备记录，而不会因 ping 超时而终止。

entries.en: QUIC Block Mode
entries.zh: QUIC 块模式

entries.en: Rules and the request list do not apply to these flows.
entries.zh: 规则和请求列表不适用于这些流。

entries.en: Security Advisory: eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise
entries.zh: 安全通告：eMudhra 中间 CA 证书遭泄露

entries.en: Security Reminder: Unless explicitly required, do not enable the skip-server-cert-verify parameter in your MITM configuration. Enabling this option bypasses TLS certificate validation for upstream servers and may expose your connections to MITM attacks.
entries.zh: 安全提醒：除非明确需要，否则请勿在您的 MITM 配置中启用 skip-server-cert-verify 参数。启用此选项会绕过对上游服务器的 TLS 证书验证，并可能使您的连接面临 MITM 攻击。

entries.en: Set `peer-access-passthrough = false` to keep the previous behavior. Incoming connections then go through Surge with rules and request records.
entries.zh: 将 `peer-access-passthrough = false` 设置为保留之前的行为。此时，入站连接将通过 Surge，并应用规则集和请求记录。

entries.en: Tailscale: a DERP connection that receives no data for 120 seconds is now treated as dead and reconnected. Before, a silently dropped connection could lose all relayed traffic until Surge restarted.
entries.zh: Tailscale：现在，若 DERP 连接在 120 秒内未收到任何数据，则会被视为已断开并重新连接。此前，静默丢失的连接可能会导致所有转发的流量中断，直到 Surge 重启。

entries.en: Tailscale: the admin console no longer shows an update warning for devices running Surge.
entries.zh: Tailscale：管理控制台不再为运行 Surge 的设备显示更新警告。

entries.en: The built-in SOCKS5 proxy server now supports UDP ASSOCIATE. SOCKS5 clients can send UDP traffic through Surge, and it goes through your rules and policies the same way as TCP. The first datagram of each association is matched against your rules, and later datagrams use the same policy.
entries.zh: 内置的 SOCKS5 代理服务器现在支持 UDP ASSOCIATE。SOCKS5 客户端可以通过 Surge 发送 UDP 流量，这些流量会像 TCP 流量一样，经过您的规则和策略。每个关联的第一个数据报会根据您的规则进行匹配，后续数据报则使用相同的策略。

entries.en: This is needed by protocols that connect back to the peer address they see, such as the high-performance mode of Apple Screen Sharing.
entries.zh: 对于会连接回其看到的对等地址的协议（例如 Apple Screen Sharing 的高性能模式）来说，这是必需的。

entries.en: Traffic statistics: Tailscale MagicDNS hosts (`*.ts.net`) are now shown by their full hostname instead of all being grouped under `ts.net`. The per-host report now adds up entries for the same host instead of keeping only one of them.
entries.zh: 流量统计：Tailscale MagicDNS 主机（`*.ts.net`）现在会以其完整主机名显示，而不会全部归组到 `ts.net` 下。每个主机的报告现在会将相同主机的条目进行汇总，而不再是仅保留其中一条。

entries.en: Traffic this device sends to a peer address goes straight into the tunnel.
entries.zh: 此设备发送到对等地址的流量会直接进入隧道。

entries.en: UDP forwarded through Tailscale or WireGuard now keeps the client's source port when that port is free.
entries.zh: 现在，通过 Tailscale 或 WireGuard 转发的 UDP 流量在源端口空闲时，会保留客户端的源端口。

entries.en: [iOS] Fixed Map Local data files larger than 2 MB being rejected on iOS. The limit is now 15 MB, as the manual says.
entries.zh: [iOS] 修复了在 iOS 上被拒绝的大小超过 2 MB 的地图本地数据文件的问题。现在，限制已调整为 15 MB，与手册中的说明一致。

entries.en: [iOS] The global `block-quic` setting can now be changed in the proxy list editor on iOS, as on Mac.
entries.zh: [iOS] 现在可以在 iOS 上的代理列表编辑器中更改全局 `block-quic` 设置，与 Mac 上的操作方式相同。

entries.en: `$httpClient`: percent-encoded usernames and passwords in the URL are now decoded before they are sent as Basic auth. A response body that cannot be decoded is now reported as an error.
entries.zh: `$httpClient`: 现在，URL 中经过百分号编码的用户名和密码在作为基础身份验证发送前会先被解码。无法解码的响应正文现会报告为错误。

entries.en: Fixed iCloud Drive sync no longer pulling changes from other devices. Local changes were still uploaded. The problem came from a lock file with missing write permission left behind by older versions. Surge now repairs that file automatically.
entries.zh: 修复了 iCloud Drive 同步无法再从其他设备拉取更改的问题。本地更改仍会正常上传。该问题源于旧版本遗留下来的一个缺少写入权限的锁定文件。Surge 现在会自动修复该文件。

entries.en: Peer Access
entries.zh: 对等访问

entries.en: Removed the 1,000,000 entry limit on rule sets and domain sets.
entries.zh: 移除了规则集和域集上 1,000,000 条目的限制。

entries.en: Rule Sets
entries.zh: 规则集

entries.en: [Mac] New "Disable UDP Fast Path" option in the gateway settings. When a device creates many UDP flows in a short time (for example, P2P downloads), Surge VM normally moves it to the UDP Fast Path. That path forwards its UDP traffic directly at L3 without applying rules. Turn this option on to stop using the fast path for all devices, so all UDP traffic always goes through your rules.
entries.zh: [Mac] 网关设置中新增“禁用 UDP 快速路径”选项。当设备在短时间内创建大量 UDP 流时（例如 P2P 下载），Surge VM 通常会将这些流移至 UDP 快速路径。该路径会直接在 L3 层转发 UDP 流量，而不会应用任何规则。启用此选项后，所有设备都将不再使用快速路径，从而确保所有 UDP 流量始终经过您的规则。

entries.en: `peer-access-passthrough` has been removed due to its side effects, and the behavior has been restored to the previous version. Special handling for Apple Screen Sharing is now built in and works without any configuration.
entries.zh: 由于 `peer-access-passthrough` 存在副作用，现已被移除，其行为已恢复为先前版本。现在已内置针对 Apple 屏幕共享的特殊处理，无需任何配置即可正常工作。

entries.en: As we focus on finalizing the new major version and getting everything ready for its launch, TestFlight updates will be temporarily paused. During this period, no new beta builds will be distributed through TestFlight.
entries.zh: 在我们专注于完成新重大版本的最终开发并为其发布做好准备期间，TestFlight 更新将暂时暂停。在此期间，我们将不会通过 TestFlight 分发任何新的测试版本构建。

entries.en: Stay tuned — we'll be back soon with more updates!
entries.zh: 敬请期待 — 我们很快将带来更多更新！

entries.en: Surge iOS 6 Is on the Way!
entries.zh: Surge iOS 6 正在路上！

entries.en: Thank you for your continued support and patience.
entries.zh: 感谢您持续的支持与耐心。

entries.en: This is a planned pause as we transition to the next major release. TestFlight updates will resume once we're ready to move forward with testing Surge iOS 6.
entries.zh: 这是我们在过渡到下一个主要版本期间计划进行的暂停。一旦我们准备好继续测试 Surge iOS 6，TestFlight 更新就会恢复。

entries.en: We're currently preparing for the upcoming release of Surge iOS 6.
entries.zh: 我们目前正在为即将发布的 Surge iOS 6 做准备。

entries.en: A Free Update
entries.zh: 免费更新

entries.en: Full introduction and release notes: [https://nssurge.com/surge-ios-6](https://nssurge.com/surge-ios-6)
entries.zh: 完整介绍和发布说明：[https://nssurge.com/surge-ios-6](https://nssurge.com/surge-ios-6)

entries.en: If your update subscription has expired, you can now try every feature free for 7 days. Explore what’s new first, then decide whether to renew.
entries.zh: 如果您的更新订阅已过期，现在可以免费试用所有功能 7 天。先探索新功能，再决定是否续订。

entries.en: Surge 6 also removes the update-subscription requirement from proxy protocols, every protocol is now available to every Surge user. (WireGuard, Tailscale, and SSH are excluded because they are not proxy protocols.)
entries.zh: Surge 6 还从代理协议中移除了更新订阅的要求，现在所有协议都对所有 Surge 用户开放。（WireGuard、Tailscale 和 SSH 除外，因为它们不是代理协议。）

entries.en: Surge iOS 6 Beta Is Now on TestFlight
entries.zh: Surge iOS 6 Beta 现已在 TestFlight 上发布

entries.en: Surge iOS 6 is rebuilt for iOS 26: a new Home screen, Liquid Glass throughout, a faster request list, versioned profiles, and an MCP server for AI agents.
entries.zh: Surge iOS 6 已为 iOS 26 重新构建：全新的主屏幕、贯穿始终的液态玻璃效果、更快的请求列表、带版本号的配置文件，以及用于 AI 智能体的 MCP 服务器。

entries.en: Surge iOS 6.0 is a free update with a huge number of improvements to the interface and the core engine. Only a few new features need an active update subscription: the new Home screen, Profile History, and the MCP server.
entries.zh: Surge iOS 6.0 是一款免费更新，对界面和核心引擎进行了大量改进。只有少数新功能需要有效的更新订阅：新的主屏幕、配置文件历史记录以及 MCP 服务器。

entries.en: We redesigned and reorganized almost every screen.
entries.zh: 我们重新设计和整理了几乎每个屏幕。

entries.en: We’ve used this blue-purple palette since Surge v3 in 2018, long before the AI era. Surge iOS 6 builds on it and brings in the design language of Surge Mac 6 and Liquid Glass. We spent a lot of time refining the result.
entries.zh: 自 2018 年 Surge v3 起，我们就开始使用这种蓝紫色调色板，那还远早于 AI 时代。Surge iOS 6 在此基础上，融入了 Surge Mac 6 和 Liquid Glass 的设计语言。我们投入了大量时间来打磨最终效果。

entries.en: What’s New
entries.zh: 新增内容

entries.en: When you first see the new colors, you might think “this looks like AI slop.” Well, it’s not.
entries.zh: 当你第一次看到这些新颜色时，你可能会想“这看起来像是 AI 的敷衍之作”。其实并非如此。

entries.en: • Engine: Tailscale exit node and subnet routes, WireGuard listen port, adaptive QUIC blocking, UDP over SOCKS5 Wi-Fi Access, and no more rule set size limit. All of these are shared with Surge Mac 6.11.
entries.zh: • 引擎：Tailscale 出口节点和子网路由、WireGuard 监听端口、自适应 QUIC 阻塞、UDP over SOCKS5 Wi-Fi 访问，且不再限制规则集大小。所有这些功能均与 Surge Mac 6.11 共享。

entries.en: • Home: Your network at a glance. Activity, Network, External IP, Bandwidth, DNS, Usage, Top Traffic, Policy Latency, and Events all live on one dashboard.
entries.zh: • 主页：一目了然地掌握您的网络。活动、网络、外部 IP、带宽、DNS、使用情况、流量排名、策略组延迟以及事件，全部显示在一个仪表盘中。

entries.en: • Liquid Glass: Configure, policy group cards, and menus use the new iOS 26 material. Menus open right where you tap.
entries.zh: • 液态玻璃：配置、策略组卡片和菜单均采用全新的 iOS 26 材质。菜单在您轻点的位置直接打开。

entries.en: • MCP Server: Agents like Claude Code get the same control as surge-cli. MCP apps on the iPhone itself, such as FlowDown and Minis, can drive Surge directly.

entries.en: • Profile History: Every save is a version. Review changes before saving, compare any two versions, and roll back in one tap.
entries.zh: • 配置文件历史记录：每次保存都是一个版本。在保存前查看更改内容，比较任意两个版本，并通过一次轻触即可回滚。

entries.en: • Requests: Every row shows a site icon, status color, and protocol badge. A filter bar stays pinned to the top of the list.

entries.en: • iPad and iPhone Duo: When there’s room, Surge switches to two panes, so the dashboard stays next to your settings.
entries.zh: • iPad 和 iPhone 组合：当空间允许时，Surge 会切换为双窗格模式，使仪表板始终紧挨着您的设置。

entries.en: Fixed home widgets and controls sometimes still showing the old state after Surge was started or stopped from Shortcuts or an automation.
entries.zh: 修复了从“捷径”或自动化中启动或停止 Surge 后，主屏幕小组件和控制项有时仍会显示旧状态的问题。

entries.en: Fixed policy group cards running under the tab bar or collapsing into a single narrow column on the iPhone Duo outer display.
entries.zh: 修复了在 iPhone Duo 外屏上，策略组卡片运行于标签栏下方或折叠成单列窄栏的问题。

entries.en: Fixed the Modules page jumping toward the end when you collapsed a category.
entries.zh: 修复了当折叠一个类别时，模块页面会跳转到底部的问题。

entries.en: Adaptive mode now allows QUIC for a host only when there is clear evidence that the app cannot fall back. That means no TCP connection appears within 0.5 seconds of the block, and the app retries over QUIC within 3 seconds. The retry goes through right away. Before, the lack of a TCP connection alone was enough, but the app might simply have cancelled the request. If a TCP connection shows up within the 3 seconds, QUIC is blocked again. When neither happens, nothing is remembered.
entries.zh: 自适应模式现在仅在明确证明应用程序无法回退时，才允许主机使用 QUIC。这意味着在 0.5 秒内不会出现 TCP 连接，并且应用程序会在 3 秒内通过 QUIC 重试。该重试会立即执行。此前，仅缺少 TCP 连接这一条件就足以触发该行为，但应用程序可能只是取消了请求。如果在 3 秒内出现 TCP 连接，QUIC 将再次被阻止。如果两种情况均未发生，则不会记录任何信息。

entries.en: If you want to return to the background of the previous version, simply select Dark + Vivid.
entries.zh: 如果您想返回上一版本的背景，只需选择“深色 + 鲜艳”即可。

entries.en: In the new beta version, all of Surge's external control capabilities, including surge-cli, AI Skills, MCP, and the HTTP API, now have the ability to modify profiles.
entries.zh: 在新版 Beta 版本中，Surge 的所有外部控制功能，包括 surge-cli、AI 技能、MCP 和 HTTP API，现在都具备修改配置文件的能力。

entries.en: Tailscale: Surge now finds a direct path to a peer that is behind NAT on the local network, such as a tailscaled container on a Docker bridge. Before, such a peer kept using DERP or a distant peer relay.

entries.zh: • 修复了当测试行被点击时“网络诊断”发生跳转的问题。

entries.en: • Fixed Surge reloading the network state every 30 seconds while an interface had an IPv4 address but no default route.
entries.zh: • 修复了当某个网络接口拥有 IPv4 地址但没有默认路由时，Surge 每 30 秒重新加载网络状态的问题。

entries.en: • Fixed a `max-size` value that is not one of the presets being reset to Default when the script was saved.

entries.zh: • 修复了从请求详情页面进行的第二次规则编辑未保存的问题。

entries.en: • Fixed capture limits set through surge-cli or MCP being ignored on a device that had never saved them in the app (for example `set ReplicaSessionParameters.timeLimit=600`). The command reported success, but the session still stopped at the default limits.

entries.en: • Fixed iCloud Drive background sync staying disabled for too many files after a `.git` folder was removed from the Surge iCloud folder.

entries.zh: • 修复了 iPhone Duo 的布局问题。

entries.en: • Fixed the Customize Home panel having no background before iOS 26, so its options were drawn on top of the cards.
entries.zh: • 修复了在 iOS 26 之前“自定义主屏幕”面板没有背景的问题，导致其选项会绘制在卡片上方。

entries.en: • Fixed the Modules page moving the category header off screen when you expanded a long category near the end of the page.
entries.zh: • 修复了在页面底部展开长类别时，模块页会将类别标题移出屏幕的问题。

entries.en: • Fixed the app icon picker.
entries.zh: • 修复了应用图标选择器。

entries.en: • Fixed the home tab title moving up under the Dynamic Island while Surge is stopped, on versions before iOS 26.
entries.zh: • 修复了在 iOS 26 之前的版本中，当 Surge 停止时，主页标签页标题向上移动到灵动岛下方的问题。

entries.en: • Fixed the primary IPv4 interface staying empty on static IPv4 setups after the default route briefly disappeared during a network change. Surge now watches default route changes and checks again.

entries.en: • Fixed the script `max-size` popup showing "Default (1024 KB)". The Mac default is 10 MB.
entries.zh: • 修复了脚本 `max-size` 弹出窗口中显示“默认 (1024 KB)”的问题。Mac 的默认值为 10 MB。

entries.en: • HTTP capture sessions saved to disk can now be read through surge-cli, MCP and the HTTP API. Before, only the recent requests in memory were available. Each channel can list sessions, browse a session's requests with paging and a filter, and read request and response bodies:
entries.zh: • 现在，保存到磁盘的 HTTP 捕获会话可以通过 surge-cli、MCP 和 HTTP API 读取。之前，只有内存中的最近请求可用。每个通道都可以列出会话、分页浏览会话中的请求（并应用筛选器），以及读取请求和响应主体：

entries.en: • Hosts in this list work even without a CA configured.
entries.zh: • 此列表中的主机即使未配置 CA 也能正常工作。

entries.en: • In the request list, Modified requests now have their own purple status dot, and Establishing requests a gray one. Before, Modified looked the same as Completed (green), and Establishing the same as Active (yellow). This applies to Surge Dashboard and iOS.
entries.zh: • 在请求列表中，已修改的请求现在有其专属的紫色状态点，而正在建立的请求则为灰色状态点。此前，已修改的请求与已完成（绿色）的请求外观相同，正在建立的请求也与活动（黄色）的请求外观相同。此变更适用于 Surge 仪表盘和 iOS 版本。

entries.en: • Intermediate certificates from the item are sent along.
entries.zh: • 项目中的中间证书将一并发送。

entries.en: • Items are shown in one list sorted by name, so a moved item stays in place.
entries.zh: • 项目按名称排序后显示在一个列表中，因此移动后的项目会保持在原位。

entries.en: • Keystore: each item now shows on its row where it is stored, in the profile or in the keychain. Tap the row to move or delete it.
entries.zh: • 密钥库：现在，每个项目都会在其所在行显示其存储位置（在配置文件中还是在钥匙串中）。轻点该行即可移动或删除它。

entries.en: • Log file size can now be set in More Settings → Advanced.
entries.zh: • 现在可以在“更多设置”→“高级”中设置日志文件大小。

entries.en: • Long-press an added custom icon set to copy its URL, update it or delete it.
entries.zh: • 长按已添加的自定义图标集，即可复制其 URL、更新或删除它。

entries.en: • MCP tools `list_capture_sessions`, `list_capture_session_requests` and `get_capture_session_body`
entries.zh: • MCP 工具 `list_capture_sessions`、`list_capture_session_requests` 和 `get_capture_session_body`

entries.en: • Marks are cleared when Surge restarts, like overrides.
entries.zh: • 与覆盖项一样，当 Surge 重启时，标记会被清除。

entries.en: • New `[MITM] server-certificates = <hostname>:<keystore item>, ...` decrypts the listed hosts with your own certificate, such as a publicly trusted one, instead of one signed by Surge's CA. Use it to inspect apps that pin their certificate or reject user-installed CAs.
entries.zh: • 新的 `[MITM] server-certificates = <hostname>:<keystore item>, ...` 会使用您自己的证书（例如受公众信任的证书）来解密列出的主机，而不是使用 Surge 的 CA 签发的证书。您可以使用它来检查那些固定了其证书或拒绝用户安装的 CA 的应用程序。

entries.en: • New `log-file-size-limit` option in `[General]` sets the maximum log file size in MB. You can also set it in General → Log. When it is not set, the old limits still apply: 200 MB on Mac and 50 MB on iOS, doubled for verbose logging.
entries.zh: • `[General]` 中的新 `log-file-size-limit` 选项用于设置日志文件的最大大小（单位：MB）。您也可以在“常规”→“日志”中进行设置。如果未设置，则仍适用旧有限制：Mac 上为 200 MB，iOS 上为 50 MB；详细日志记录时，这些限制会翻倍。

entries.en: • New `surge-cli dump traffic-stat-breakdown <primary> <secondary>` groups traffic statistics by two of host, policy, interface, process and device. For example, `dump traffic-stat-breakdown policy host` lists each policy's hosts. The same data is available through MCP.
entries.zh: • 新的 `surge-cli dump traffic-stat-breakdown <primary> <secondary>` 可根据主机、策略、接口、进程和设备中的两项对流量统计信息进行分组。例如，`dump traffic-stat-breakdown policy host` 会列出每个策略组的主机。您也可以通过 MCP 获取相同的数据。

entries.en: • New `surge-cli dump traffic-stat-records <today|this-month|last-month>` returns one period's traffic statistics, merged by host, policy and interface. The same data is available through MCP.
entries.zh: • 新的 `surge-cli dump traffic-stat-records <today|this-month|last-month>` 返回一个时间段的流量统计信息，按主机、策略和接口合并。相同数据也可通过 MCP 获取。

entries.en: • New `surge-cli policy-avoid list|add|remove|clear`, the MCP tool `set_policy_avoidance` and the HTTP API `GET` / `POST /v1/policies/avoided`. `policy-group` now reports the avoided members of automatic groups.
entries.zh: • 新增 `surge-cli policy-avoid list|add|remove|clear`、MCP 工具 `set_policy_avoidance` 以及 HTTP API `GET` / `POST /v1/policies/avoided`。`policy-group` 现在会报告自动策略组中被排除的成员。

entries.en: • New capture sessions now also record their start and end time, limits, filter and why they ended.
entries.zh: • 新的捕获会话现在还会记录其开始和结束时间、限制、过滤器以及结束原因。

entries.en: • Policy group editors now offer `CELLULAR`, `CELLULAR-ONLY`, `HYBRID` and `NO-HYBRID`. Before, the editor did not list them, and they were dropped on save when added by hand.
entries.zh: • 策略组编辑器现在提供 `CELLULAR`、`CELLULAR-ONLY`、`HYBRID` 和 `NO-HYBRID`。此前，编辑器未列出这些规则集，手动添加后保存时会将其删除。

entries.en: • Profile History: swipe to delete a single version. The next newer version takes over the deleted version's changes.
entries.zh: • 配置文件历史记录：向左滑动可删除单个版本。下一个更新的版本将继承被删除版本所做的更改。

entries.en: • Request details now offer Add Temporary Rule for remote iOS and tvOS devices.
entries.zh: • 请求详情现可为远程 iOS 和 tvOS 设备提供“添加临时规则”功能。

entries.en: • Select and subnet groups, temporary overrides, and policies referenced directly are not affected.
entries.zh: • 直接引用的子网分组、临时覆盖项和策略组不受影响。

entries.en: • Surge logs a host the certificate doesn't cover, and shows invalid entries as profile warnings.
entries.zh: • Surge 会记录证书未覆盖的主机，并将无效条目作为配置文件警告显示。

entries.en: • Tailscale and WireGuard: connections from this device to its own tunnel address or MagicDNS name now reach the device itself. Before, they timed out.
entries.zh: • Tailscale 和 WireGuard：现在，从此设备到其自身隧道地址或 MagicDNS 名称的连接可以到达设备本身。之前，这些连接会超时。

entries.en: • The MitM settings page has an editor for `server-certificates`, with a keystore picker and a hint that shows whether the certificate covers the hostname.
entries.zh: • MitM 设置页面为 `server-certificates` 提供了一个编辑器，其中包含一个密钥库选择器和一个提示信息，用于显示证书是否覆盖主机名。

entries.zh: 密钥库：现在，每个项目都会在其所在行显示其存储位置（在配置文件中还是在钥匙串中）。轻点该行即可移动或删除它。

entries.en: Liquid Glass: Configure, policy group cards, and menus use the new iOS 26 material. Menus open right where you tap.
entries.zh: Liquid Glass：配置、策略组卡片和菜单均采用全新的 iOS 26 材质。菜单在您轻点的位置直接打开。

entries.en: Log file size can now be set in More Settings → Advanced.
entries.zh: 现在可以在“更多设置”→“高级”中设置日志文件大小。

entries.en: Long-press an added custom icon set to copy its URL, update it or delete it.
entries.zh: 长按已添加的自定义图标集，即可复制其 URL、更新或删除它。

entries.en: MCP Server: Agents like Claude Code get the same control as surge-cli. MCP apps on the iPhone itself, such as FlowDown and Minis, can drive Surge directly.
entries.zh: MCP 服务器：Claude Code 等智能体可获得与 surge-cli 相同的控制权。iPhone 设备上的 MCP 应用（例如 FlowDown 和 Minis）可以直接驱动 Surge。

entries.en: MCP tools `list_capture_sessions`, `list_capture_session_requests` and `get_capture_session_body`
entries.zh: MCP 工具 `list_capture_sessions`、`list_capture_session_requests` 和 `get_capture_session_body`

entries.en: Marks are cleared when Surge restarts, like overrides.
entries.zh: 与覆盖项一样，当 Surge 重启时，标记会被清除。

entries.en: New Features
entries.zh: 新功能

entries.en: New `[MITM] server-certificates = <hostname>:<keystore item>, ...` decrypts the listed hosts with your own certificate, such as a publicly trusted one, instead of one signed by Surge's CA. Use it to inspect apps that pin their certificate or reject user-installed CAs.
entries.zh: 新的 `[MITM] server-certificates = <hostname>:<keystore item>, ...` 会使用您自己的证书（例如受公众信任的证书）来解密列出的主机，而不是使用 Surge 的 CA 签发的证书。您可以使用它来检查那些固定了其证书或拒绝用户安装的 CA 的应用程序。

entries.en: New `log-file-size-limit` option in `[General]` sets the maximum log file size in MB. You can also set it in General → Log. When it is not set, the old limits still apply: 200 MB on Mac and 50 MB on iOS, doubled for verbose logging.
entries.zh: `log-file-size-limit` 中的新 `[General]` 选项用于设置日志文件的最大大小（单位：MB）。您也可以在“常规”→“日志”中进行设置。如果未设置，则仍适用旧有限制：Mac 上为 200 MB，iOS 上为 50 MB；详细日志记录时，这些限制会翻倍。

entries.en: New `surge-cli dump traffic-stat-breakdown <primary> <secondary>` groups traffic statistics by two of host, policy, interface, process and device. For example, `dump traffic-stat-breakdown policy host` lists each policy's hosts. The same data is available through MCP.
entries.zh: 新的 `surge-cli dump traffic-stat-breakdown <primary> <secondary>` 按主机、策略、接口、进程和设备中的两项对流量统计信息进行分组。例如，`dump traffic-stat-breakdown policy host` 列出了每个策略的主机。您也可以通过 MCP 获取相同的数据。

entries.en: New `surge-cli dump traffic-stat-records <today|this-month|last-month>` returns one period's traffic statistics, merged by host, policy and interface. The same data is available through MCP.
entries.zh: 新的 `surge-cli dump traffic-stat-records <today|this-month|last-month>` 返回一个时间段的流量统计信息，按主机、策略和接口进行合并。相同数据也可通过 MCP 获取。

entries.en: New `surge-cli policy-avoid list|add|remove|clear`, the MCP tool `set_policy_avoidance` and the HTTP API `GET` / `POST /v1/policies/avoided`. `policy-group` now reports the avoided members of automatic groups.
entries.zh: 新增 `surge-cli policy-avoid list|add|remove|clear`、MCP 工具 `set_policy_avoidance` 以及 HTTP API `GET` / `POST /v1/policies/avoided`。`policy-group` 现在会报告自动策略组中已避免的成员。

entries.en: New capture sessions now also record their start and end time, limits, filter and why they ended.
entries.zh: 新的捕获会话现在还会记录其开始和结束时间、限制、过滤器以及结束原因。

entries.en: Policy group editors now offer `CELLULAR`, `CELLULAR-ONLY`, `HYBRID` and `NO-HYBRID`. Before, the editor did not list them, and they were dropped on save when added by hand.
entries.zh: 策略组编辑器现在提供 `CELLULAR`、`CELLULAR-ONLY`、`HYBRID` 和 `NO-HYBRID`。之前，编辑器未列出这些规则集，手动添加后在保存时会将其删除。

entries.en: Profile History: Every save is a version. Review changes before saving, compare any two versions, and roll back in one tap.
entries.zh: 配置文件历史记录：每次保存都会生成一个版本。可在保存前查看更改内容，比较任意两个版本，并通过一次轻触进行回滚。

entries.en: Profile History: swipe to delete a single version. The next newer version takes over the deleted version's changes.
entries.zh: 配置文件历史记录：向左滑动可删除单个版本。下一个更新的版本将继承被删除版本所做的更改。

entries.en: Request details now offer Add Temporary Rule for remote iOS and tvOS devices.
entries.zh: 请求详情现可为远程 iOS 和 tvOS 设备添加临时规则。

entries.en: Requests: Every row shows a site icon, status color, and protocol badge. A filter bar stays pinned to the top of the list.
entries.zh: 请求：每一行都显示一个网站图标、状态颜色和协议徽章。筛选栏始终固定在列表顶部。

entries.en: Select and subnet groups, temporary overrides, and policies referenced directly are not affected.
entries.zh: 已选择和子网分组的组、临时覆盖项以及直接引用的策略组不受影响。

entries.en: Surge CLI
entries.zh: Surge CLI

entries.en: Surge Mac
entries.zh: Surge Mac

entries.en: Surge iOS
entries.zh: Surge iOS

entries.en: Surge logs a host the certificate doesn't cover, and shows invalid entries as profile warnings.
entries.zh: Surge 记录了一个证书未覆盖的主机，并将无效条目显示为配置文件警告。

entries.en: Tailscale and WireGuard: connections from this device to its own tunnel address or MagicDNS name now reach the device itself. Before, they timed out.
entries.zh: Tailscale 和 WireGuard：现在，从此设备到其自身隧道地址或 MagicDNS 名称的连接可以成功到达设备本身。此前，这些连接会超时。

entries.en: The MitM settings page has an editor for `server-certificates`, with a keystore picker and a hint that shows whether the certificate covers the hostname.
entries.zh: MitM 设置页面为 `server-certificates` 提供了一个编辑器，其中包含一个密钥库选择器，以及一个用于显示证书是否覆盖主机名的提示信息。

entries.en: The Traffic Statistics tab has a new Breakdown button in the bottom bar. Pick Host or Policy, and each row expands to show its policies or hosts, ranked by today, this month and last month.
entries.zh: “流量统计”选项卡的底部工具栏中新增了一个“细分”按钮。选择“主机”或“策略”，即可展开每一行，查看其策略或主机，并按今天、本月和上月的情况进行排序。

entries.en: The first matching entry wins. If its PKCS #12 item cannot be loaded, Surge falls back to a CA-signed certificate.
entries.zh: 第一个匹配项生效。如果其 PKCS #12 项目无法加载，Surge 将回退到由 CA 签发的证书。

entries.en: The remote controller now has a Traffic Statistics tool for a remote Mac or iOS device. It has the same periods, grouping, details and export as the local page. The remote device must run a version that includes this update.
entries.zh: 现在，远程控制器为远程 Mac 或 iOS 设备提供了“流量统计”工具。该工具与本地页面具有相同的周期、分组、详细信息和导出功能。远程设备必须运行包含此更新的版本。

entries.en: Traffic details: long hostnames now wrap, and the traffic amount moves below the name instead of being pushed off the row. Long-press a host, policy or interface row to copy its name.
entries.zh: 流量详情：现在长主机名会换行显示，流量数值会移至名称下方，而不会挤出行外。长按主机、策略或接口行即可复制其名称。

entries.en: When adding an item, you now enter the content first. The name is then prefilled from the file name or the SSH key comment, in the same prompt as the PKCS #12 password.
entries.zh: 现在添加项目时，您需要先输入内容。然后，系统会在与 PKCS #12 密码相同的提示框中，根据文件名或 SSH 密钥注释预填充名称。

entries.en: You can now mark a policy as avoided. Use this when a policy passes latency tests but performs poorly in practice, for example with low bandwidth. Automatic groups (`url-test`, `fallback`, `load-balance` and `smart`) skip an avoided policy as long as any other member is usable. If nothing else is left, the avoided policy is still used.
entries.zh: 现在，您可以将某项策略标记为“已避免”。当某项策略通过延迟测试但在实际使用中表现不佳（例如带宽较低）时，可使用此功能。只要自动策略组（`url-test`、`fallback`、`load-balance` 和 `smart`）中的其他任何成员均可使用，该策略组就会跳过“已避免”的策略。如果别无选择，仍会使用“已避免”的策略。

entries.en: You can now swipe left or right on the policy group page to switch categories.
entries.zh: 现在，您可以在策略组页面左滑或右滑以切换类别。

entries.en: `GET /v1/capture/sessions`, `/v1/capture/sessions/requests` and `/v1/capture/sessions/data`
entries.zh: `GET /v1/capture/sessions`、`/v1/capture/sessions/requests` 和 `/v1/capture/sessions/data`

entries.en: `surge-cli capture-session list | dump <session> | data <session> <key> <request|response>`
entries.zh: `surge-cli capture-session list | dump <session> | data <session> <key> <request|response>`

entries.en: iPad and iPhone Duo: When there’s room, Surge switches to two panes, so the dashboard stays next to your settings.
entries.zh: iPad 和 iPhone 组合：当空间允许时，Surge 会切换为双窗格模式，使仪表板始终紧挨着您的设置。

entries.en: iPhone Duo: the inner screen now uses a single column in portrait. Before, the Configure cards overlapped. The sidebar button, which could hide the sidebar with no way to bring it back, has been removed.
entries.zh: iPhone Duo：现在，内屏在竖屏模式下使用单列显示。之前，配置卡片会相互重叠。现已移除侧边栏按钮，该按钮会隐藏侧边栏且无法将其恢复。

entries.en: Check the website for more information: [https://nssurge.com/surge-ios-6](https://nssurge.com/surge-ios-6)
entries.zh: 请访问网站了解更多信息：[https://nssurge.com/surge-ios-6](https://nssurge.com/surge-ios-6)

entries.en: Surge iOS 6 TestFlight Update
entries.zh: Surge iOS 6 TestFlight 更新

entries.en: This beta version includes extensive updates to visual styles and interactions. We will continue to optimize and iterate on the design and interactions throughout the beta period. Stay tuned.
entries.zh: 此 Beta 版本包含对视觉样式和交互的大量更新。我们将在整个 Beta 测试期间持续优化和迭代设计和交互。敬请期待。

entries.en: Categories
entries.zh: 类别

entries.en: Configure, Policy Group and Modules now share one category bar.
entries.zh: 配置、策略组和模块现在共享一个类别栏。

entries.en: Continue with major user interface transformation and optimization.
entries.zh: 继续进行重大的用户界面转换与优化。

entries.en: However, because Surge strictly honors the IP DF flag, it rejects large UDP packets with the DF flag set by returning an ICMP Packet Too Big message. But because Hysteria 2’s maximum per-packet payload size is too low, some UDP services are completely unusable.
entries.zh: 然而，由于 Surge 严格遵循 IP DF 标志，它会通过返回 ICMP Packet Too Big 消息来拒绝设置了 DF 标志的大 UDP 数据包。但由于 Hysteria 2 的每个数据包最大有效载荷大小过低，某些 UDP 服务完全无法使用。

entries.en: Hysteria 2: Oversized UDP Packets Now Fragmented
entries.zh: Hysteria 2：超大 UDP 数据包现已被分片

entries.en: Hysteria 2: Oversized UDP packets now fragmented
entries.zh: Hysteria 2：超大 UDP 数据包现已被分片

entries.en: Modules
entries.zh: 模块

entries.en: New "Call HTTP API" action sends a GET or POST request to the running Surge and returns the response. `http-api` does not need to be configured.
entries.zh: 新增的“调用 HTTP API”操作会向正在运行的 Surge 发送 GET 或 POST 请求，并返回响应。无需配置 `http-api`。

entries.en: New "Run Surge CLI Command" action runs a surge-cli command and returns its output, optionally as raw JSON. Commands that keep streaming output, such as `watch` and `diagnostics`, are not supported.
entries.zh: 新增的“运行 Surge CLI 命令”操作可运行一个 surge-cli 命令并返回其输出，也可选择以原始 JSON 格式返回。不支持会持续流式输出的命令，例如 `watch` 和 `diagnostics`。

entries.en: Please note that this version contains some migration logic for internal data. Once updated to the new version, if you roll back to an older version, some statistical data may be lost.
entries.zh: 请注意，此版本包含一些用于内部数据的迁移逻辑。一旦更新到新版本，如果您回退到旧版本，部分统计数据可能会丢失。

entries.en: Shortcuts
entries.zh: 快捷方式

entries.en: Since v2.6.4, official Hysteria 2 servers have capped QUIC datagrams at 1,200 bytes, regardless of the network MTU. The protocol handles larger packets by fragmenting them.
entries.zh: 自 v2.6.4 以来，官方的 Hysteria 2 服务器已将 QUIC 数据报限制为 1,200 字节，无论网络 MTU 如何。该协议通过分片来处理更大的数据包。

entries.en: Starting with the beta update, Surge relays UDP packets of any size through Hysteria 2 policies using fragmentation. Previously, packets marked Don’t Fragment (DF) and larger than about 1,130 bytes were dropped.
entries.zh: 从 Beta 更新开始，Surge 会通过 Hysteria 2 策略组，利用分片技术转发任意大小的 UDP 数据包。此前，被标记为“不分片”（DF）且大小超过约 1130 字节的数据包会被丢弃。

entries.en: Tailscale: a new web sign-in now takes effect right away. Before, the policy kept failing with the old or missing login until Surge was restarted.
entries.zh: Tailscale：新的网页登录功能现已即时生效。此前，在 Surge 重启之前，该策略会因旧登录信息或登录信息缺失而持续失败。

entries.en: Tailscale: fixed a routing loop when a peer sends its own Tailscale traffic back into the tailnet, for example a tsnet program that uses this device as an exit node or a subnet router. Surge mistook the looped traffic for a direct path and kept using it, at DERP-level latency.
entries.zh: Tailscale：修复了一个路由环路问题，当对等方将其自身的 Tailscale 流量重新发送回 tailnet 时（例如，使用此设备作为出口节点或子网路由器的 tsnet 程序），就会触发该问题。Surge 曾误将环路流量识别为直接路径，并持续使用它，导致延迟达到 DERP 级别。

entries.en: The Configure favorites star appears only after you set up favorite cards in More → Appearance → Favorite Cards. It is the first item on the category bar.
entries.zh: “配置收藏夹”星标仅在您通过“更多”→“外观”→“收藏夹卡片”设置了收藏夹卡片后才会出现。它是类别栏上的第一个项目。

entries.en: The left and right swiping of these pages now slides along with the gesture, rather than being a simple gesture operation.
entries.zh: 现在，左右滑动这些页面时，页面会随着手势滑动，而不再只是执行简单的手势操作。

entries.en: The modules page now shows one category at a time, chosen on the category bar. Search still covers every category.
entries.zh: 模块页面现在一次只显示一个类别，类别由类别栏选择。搜索功能仍然涵盖所有类别。

entries.en: Continue optimization and adjustment of UI details.
entries.zh: 继续优化和调整 UI 细节。

entries.en: External Control
entries.zh: 外部控制

entries.en: Request notes no longer list sub-rules from an AND/OR/NOT branch that did not match.
entries.zh: 请求日志中不再列出未匹配的 AND/OR/NOT 分支中的子规则。

entries.en: Tailscale: a rejected or expired auth key is now raised as a warning. It also appears in Events and the Logbook, and stays until the node is authorized again. Before, it only showed a notification that disappeared after 10 seconds.
entries.zh: Tailscale：被拒绝或过期的授权密钥现在会作为警告提示。它也会显示在“事件”和“日志簿”中，并会一直保留，直到节点被重新授权。此前，它只会显示一条 10 秒后就会消失的通知。

entries.en: WireGuard and Tailscale: changing [Proxy] or [Proxy Group] no longer rebuilds every WireGuard and Tailscale session. A session is kept when its policy line and its own section are unchanged, so connections through it keep working. Before, a change made over the tailnet (for example, from a controller on a peer) cut off its own reply.
entries.zh: WireGuard 和 Tailscale：更改 [Proxy] 或 [Proxy Group] 后，将不再重建所有 WireGuard 和 Tailscale 会话。当某个会话的策略行及其自身部分保持不变时，该会话将被保留，因此通过它建立的连接仍可继续工作。此前，在 tailnet 上进行的更改（例如，由对等节点上的控制器发起的更改）会中断其自身的响应。

entries.en: `module list` now returns details for each module: its type, every `#!` header field, the declared argument names, the file modification time, and the effective lines in each section after loading with the stored arguments (or the load error). The new `module show <name>` command also includes the module's text. Available in surge-cli, MCP (`list_modules` and the new `get_module`), and the HTTP API (`GET /v1/modules` and the new `/v1/modules/detail`).
entries.zh: `module list` 现在会返回每个模块的详细信息：其类型、每个 `#!` 标头字段、声明的参数名称、文件修改时间，以及使用存储的参数加载后每个部分中的有效行（或加载错误）。新的 `module show <name>` 命令还包含模块的文本。适用于 surge-cli、MCP（`list_modules` 和新的 `get_module`）以及 HTTP API（`GET /v1/modules` 和新的 `/v1/modules/detail`）。

entries.en: `rule match` and `rule explain` now return where the matched rule comes from: the profile file and line, or the module that added it. For a RULE-SET or DOMAIN-SET, they also return the entry inside the set that actually matched, innermost set first.
entries.zh: `rule match` 和 `rule explain` 现在会返回匹配规则的来源：配置文件和行号，或添加该规则的模块。对于 RULE-SET 或 DOMAIN-SET，它们还会返回规则集内实际匹配的那一项，并从最内层的规则集开始。

entries.en: A new Global section in the card customize sheet sets how every folded card shows latency: the dot with the latency, the dot only, or nothing.
entries.zh: 卡片自定义工作表中新增了一个“全局”部分，用于设置每张折叠卡片显示延迟的方式：显示带延迟信息的圆点、仅显示圆点，或不显示任何内容。

entries.en: Always Collapsed: always the capsule. While stopped it is a blue Start button.
entries.zh: 始终折叠：始终显示胶囊。停止时显示为蓝色的“开始”按钮。

entries.en: Always Expanded (default): the slider card, which shrinks into a capsule as you scroll.
entries.zh: 始终展开（默认）：滑块卡片在您滚动时会收缩成一个胶囊状。

entries.en: Collapse When Running: the card while stopped. Once you slide to start, it turns into a capsule next to the title, and returns to a card when Surge stops.
entries.zh: 运行期间折叠：卡片在停止时会折叠。一旦您滑动以开始，它就会在标题旁边变成一个胶囊，并在 Surge 停止时恢复为卡片。

entries.en: Custom card backgrounds are back, now in every style: 63 preset graphics, system colors, a color picker, or None. Cards with a background use light text.
entries.zh: 自定义卡片背景现已回归，并提供多种样式：63 种预设图形、系统颜色、取色器或“无”。带有背景的卡片将使用浅色文本。

entries.en: Customize Home, which you can now open while Surge is stopped too, has a new Start Switch section with three styles:
entries.zh: “自定义主页”现已新增“启动切换”版块，提供三种样式，即使 Surge 已停止运行，您仍可打开该主页。

entries.en: Fixed HTTP/2 connections gradually losing receive window when streams were aborted, which could eventually stall the connection.
entries.zh: 修复了在流被中止时 HTTP/2 连接逐渐丢失接收窗口的问题，该问题最终可能导致连接停滞。

entries.en: Fixed Snell, Vector and Ponte servers dropping every IPv4 UDP datagram sent through DIRECT on NAT64 networks.
entries.zh: 修复了 Snell、Vector 和 Ponte 服务器在 NAT64 网络上通过 DIRECT 发送的每个 IPv4 UDP 数据报均被丢弃的问题。

entries.en: Fixed a WireGuard policy with `listen-port` not starting again after a profile change that replaced it, because the old session still held the port.
entries.zh: 修复了一个 WireGuard 策略组的问题：在替换它的配置文件更改后，`listen-port` 未能重新启动，因为旧会话仍占用了该端口。

entries.en: Other detail fixes and optimizations.
entries.zh: 其他细节修复与优化。

entries.en: Policy Group Cards
entries.zh: 策略组卡片

entries.en: Sanitized profiles now mask the credentials in `[General]`: the `http-api` and `external-controller-access` keys, the `http-listen` and `socks5-listen` credentials, and `wifi-access-http-auth`. This covers `GET /v1/profiles/current?sensitive=0`, the controller's profile dump and diagnostic log archives. Listen addresses stay readable, and comments at the end of those lines are removed.
entries.zh: 清理后的配置文件现在会隐藏 `[General]` 中的凭据：`http-api` 和 `external-controller-access` 键、`http-listen` 和 `socks5-listen` 凭据，以及 `wifi-access-http-auth`。这涵盖了 `GET /v1/profiles/current?sensitive=0`、控制器的配置文件转储和诊断日志存档。监听地址仍保持可读，这些行末尾的注释则被移除。

entries.en: Start Switch Styles
entries.zh: 开始切换样式

entries.en: The `set` command from surge-cli, the HTTP API or MCP now rejects a key path that cannot be assigned and returns an error. None of the values in that call are applied.
entries.zh: 现在，来自 surge-cli、HTTP API 或 MCP 的 `set` 命令会拒绝无法分配的路径键并返回错误。该调用中的任何值都不会被应用。

entries.en: Updating a module, or reinstalling it from the same URL, now downloads its scripts and rule sets again right away. Before, new versions of these resources waited for their update interval.
entries.zh: 现在，更新模块或从同一 URL 重新安装模块时，其脚本和规则集会立即重新下载。此前，这些资源的新版本会等到其更新间隔才会下载。

entries.en: `surge-cli dump` now accepts `dns-lookup-times`, `traffic-stat-hourly` and `policy-usage` and shows readable output for them. Before, these dumps only worked with `--raw`.
entries.zh: `surge-cli dump` 现在支持 `dns-lookup-times`、`traffic-stat-hourly` 和 `policy-usage`，并能为它们显示可读的输出。之前，这些转储文件仅能与 `--raw` 配合使用。

entries.en: $httpClient: percent-encoded usernames and passwords in the URL are now decoded before they are sent as Basic auth. A response body that cannot be decoded is now reported as an error.
entries.zh: $httpClient：URL 中经过百分比编码的用户名和密码现在会在作为基础身份验证发送之前被解码。无法解码的响应正文现在会报告为错误。

entries.en: 1,200-byte UDP replies were dropped.
entries.zh: 1,200 字节的 UDP 响应被丢弃。

entries.en: A Reminder for Surge iOS Users
entries.zh: 致 Surge iOS 用户的提醒

entries.en: AI-powered Testing Platform
entries.zh: AI 驱动型测试平台

entries.en: Added block-quic=adaptive for proxy policies. Surge blocks QUIC at first so the app falls back to HTTPS over TCP. QUIC is allowed for a host only when the app shows it cannot fall back, as with apps that only support QUIC: no TCP connection appears within 0.5 seconds, and the app retries over QUIC within 3 seconds. That retry goes through right away. A TCP connection within those 3 seconds means the app can fall back, and QUIC stays blocked. Results are remembered per host.
entries.zh: 为代理策略新增了 block-quic=adaptive 选项。Surge 会先阻止 QUIC，使应用回退到基于 TCP 的 HTTPS。仅当应用显示无法回退时，才允许对某个主机使用 QUIC，例如仅支持 QUIC 的应用：在 0.5 秒内未出现 TCP 连接，且应用会在 3 秒内尝试通过 QUIC 重试。该重试会立即成功。若在这 3 秒内出现 TCP 连接，则表示应用可以回退，QUIC 仍会被阻止。结果会按主机分别记忆。

entries.en: As we announced previously, protocol support on Surge iOS no longer requires an active subscription. Every supported protocol, including VLESS and REALITY, is available to all Surge iOS users for free.
entries.zh: 正如我们先前所宣布的，Surge iOS 上的协议支持不再需要有效的订阅。所有受支持的协议（包括 VLESS 和 REALITY）均可免费提供给所有 Surge iOS 用户。

entries.en: Capture filters can now be read and changed with GET / POST /v1/capture/filters.
entries.zh: 现在可以使用 GET / POST /v1/capture/filters 读取和更改捕获过滤器。

entries.en: Changing `[Proxy]`, `[Proxy Group]` or `[Keystore]` no longer cuts in-flight connections of SSH, HTTP/2 CONNECT, MASQUE, TUIC and Hysteria 2 policies whose own definition is unchanged. Their shared connections are now kept, as WireGuard and Tailscale sessions already were.
entries.zh: 更改 `[Proxy]`、`[Proxy Group]` 或 `[Keystore]` 已不再中断 SSH、HTTP/2 CONNECT、MASQUE、TUIC 和 Hysteria 2 策略中仍在传输的连接，前提是这些策略自身的定义未变。现在，它们的共享连接将被保留，正如 WireGuard 和 Tailscale 会话早已实现的那样。

entries.en: DTLS, WireGuard, STUN and other non-QUIC UDP traffic on port 443 is no longer treated as QUIC, so block-quic no longer affects it.
entries.zh: 端口 443 上的 DTLS、WireGuard、STUN 及其他非 QUIC 的 UDP 流量将不再被视为 QUIC，因此 block-quic 不再对其生效。

entries.en: Dashboard
entries.zh: 仪表板

entries.en: Faster Failures
entries.zh: 更快的故障检测

entries.en: Fixed $surge.retestGroup failing in scripts that use the WebView engine when no policy list was returned.
entries.zh: 修复了在未返回任何策略组的情况下，使用 WebView 引擎的脚本中 $surge.retestGroup 失败的问题。

entries.en: Fixed AnyTLS streams staying open for 60 seconds after the client finished sending.
entries.zh: 修复了 AnyTLS 流在客户端完成发送后仍保持打开 60 秒的问题。

entries.en: Fixed DNS lookups waiting for a timeout with some carrier DNS servers that send malformed AAAA responses.
entries.zh: 修复了在某些发送格式错误 AAAA 响应的运营商 DNS 服务器上，DNS 查找等待超时的故障。

entries.en: Fixed HEAD, 204 and 304 requests over HTTP/2 failing with some servers since 6.8.0.
entries.zh: 修复了自 6.8.0 以来，通过 HTTP/2 发出的 HEAD、204 和 304 请求在某些服务器上失败的问题。

entries.en: Fixed HTTP/2 pseudo-headers being exported to HAR with an empty name.
entries.zh: 修复了 HTTP/2 伪标头以空名称导出到 HAR 的问题。

entries.en: Fixed HTTP/2 trailers being treated as a malformed response, and buffered data being lost when a stream was reset with NO_ERROR after it had ended.
entries.zh: 修复了 HTTP/2 页脚被误判为格式错误的响应，以及在流结束后使用 NO_ERROR 重置流时缓冲数据丢失的问题。

entries.en: Fixed PROCESS-NAME rules missing short-lived processes in Enhanced Mode.
entries.zh: 修复了 Enhanced Mode 中 PROCESS-NAME 规则遗漏短时进程的问题。

entries.en: Fixed SSH servers dropping the whole session, and every tunnel on it, after Surge closed a channel twice.
entries.zh: 修复了 Surge 两次关闭通道后，SSH 服务器断开整个会话及其上所有隧道的问题。

entries.en: Fixed Shadowsocks 2022 silently dropping received UDP datagrams larger than 1,500 bytes. Full-size replies of WireGuard over Shadowsocks were all lost.
entries.zh: 修复了 Shadowsocks 2022 静默丢弃大于 1500 字节的已接收 UDP 数据报的问题。通过 Shadowsocks 传输的 WireGuard 完整尺寸回复均会丢失。

entries.en: Fixed Surge Ponte repeatedly dropping its WAN connection in some LAN setups.
entries.zh: 修复了 Surge Ponte 在某些局域网配置中反复断开 WAN 连接的问题。

entries.en: Fixed TCP never connecting through WireGuard chained over a UDP relay, such as Shadowsocks or SOCKS5, while UDP worked. Surge now lowers the inner TCP MSS to fit the extra encapsulation.
entries.zh: 修复了当 WireGuard 通过 Shadowsocks 或 SOCKS5 等 UDP 中继进行级联时，TCP 始终无法连接，而 UDP 却能正常工作的问题。Surge 现在会降低内部 TCP 的 MSS，以适应额外的封装。

entries.en: Fixed UDP over AnyTLS, Trojan and VLESS queuing without limit when the sender was faster than the connection, which could use gigabytes of memory. Datagrams are now dropped while the connection is congested.
entries.zh: 修复了当发送方速度超过连接速度时，UDP over AnyTLS、Trojan 和 VLESS 无限排队的问题，该问题可能导致消耗数 GB 内存。现在，当连接拥塞时，数据报将被丢弃。

entries.en: Fixed `$httpClient` requests over AnyTLS recording a negative upload, shown as 18446744.07 TB in traffic statistics.
entries.zh: 修复了 AnyTLS 记录中因 `$httpClient` 请求导致上传量为负数的问题，该问题在流量统计中显示为 18446744.07 TB。

entries.en: Fixed a Tailscale routing loop when a peer sends its own Tailscale traffic back into the tailnet, for example a tsnet program that uses this device as an exit node or a subnet router. Surge mistook the looped traffic for a direct path and kept using it, at DERP-level latency.
entries.zh: 修复了当对等方将其自身的 Tailscale 流量重新发回 tailnet 时出现的 Tailscale 路由环路问题，例如，某个使用本设备作为出口节点或子网路由器的 tsnet 程序。Surge 曾误将环路流量识别为直接路径并持续使用，导致其延迟达到 DERP 级别。

entries.en: Fixed a WireGuard policy with listen-port not starting again after a profile change that replaced it, because the old session still held the port.
entries.zh: 修复了 WireGuard 策略中 listen-port 在配置文件变更后被替换但未能重新启动的问题，因为旧会话仍占用了该端口。

entries.en: Fixed a crash related to incoming Tailscale and WireGuard connections.
entries.zh: 修复了一个与入站 Tailscale 和 WireGuard 连接相关的崩溃问题。

entries.en: Fixed a large number of performance issues that could occur under special configurations or environments, especially performance issues under combinations of proxy chains.
entries.zh: 修复了大量在特定配置或环境下可能出现的性能问题，尤其是在代理链组合下的性能问题。

entries.en: Fixed a load-balance group with a manual override being scored as the average of its options instead of as the overridden policy, so groups that include it could choose differently from the actual route.
entries.zh: 修复了一个问题：带有手动覆盖的路由负载均衡组，其评分被计算为各选项的平均值，而非被覆盖的策略，导致包含该组的策略组可能选择了与实际路由不同的路径。

entries.en: Fixed a module turning on or off by itself when you swiped while a row's menu was still closing.
entries.zh: 修复了在行菜单仍在关闭时进行滑动操作，导致某个模块自动开启或关闭的问题。

entries.en: Fixed a policy group card going missing, and cards no longer responding to taps, after swiping categories while a card's menu was still closing.
entries.zh: 修复了在卡片菜单仍在关闭时滑动类别后，策略组卡片消失以及卡片不再响应点击的问题。

entries.en: Fixed a swipe doing nothing on the Configure page while the page was settling back after a short swipe.
entries.zh: 修复了在短暂滑动后页面回弹期间，于“配置”页面滑动时无任何反应的问题。

entries.en: Fixed an issue where an external policy used directly as the underlying-proxy of another policy did not start its process automatically. The process only started after a latency test.
entries.zh: 修复了一个问题：当外部策略被直接用作另一策略的底层代理时，其进程不会自动启动。只有在执行延迟测试后，该进程才会启动。

entries.en: Fixed bursts of incoming connections being reset during the handshake, for example 200 SOCKS5 connections at once. This affected the HTTP and SOCKS5 proxy services, the HTTP API, the controller, the Snell server and port forwarding.
entries.zh: 修复了在握手期间入站连接突发被重置的问题，例如一次性出现 200 个 SOCKS5 连接。此问题影响了 HTTP 和 SOCKS5 代理服务、HTTP API、控制器、Snell 服务器以及端口转发功能。

entries.en: Fixed half-closed connections losing data. Examples are a client that sends a request, shuts down its sending side and then waits for the reply, or a server that finishes first:
entries.zh: 修复了半关闭连接丢失数据的问题。例如，客户端发送请求后关闭发送端并等待响应，或服务器先完成处理：

entries.en: Fixed idle TUIC connections closing after about 15 seconds with servers that announce a 15-second idle timeout. Surge's keep-alive is now at most half the negotiated idle timeout.
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器宣布 15 秒空闲超时后，空闲的 TUIC 连接在约 15 秒后被关闭的问题。现在，Surge 的保活时间最多为协商后空闲超时时间的一半。

entries.en: Fixed killing one HTTP/3 stream sometimes closing the whole HTTP/3 session, along with every tunnel on it (MASQUE, TrustTunnel with `h3=true`).
entries.zh: 修复了关闭某个 HTTP/3 流有时会关闭整个 HTTP/3 会话及其上的所有隧道（MASQUE、带有 `h3=true` 的 TrustTunnel）的问题。

entries.en: Fixed no-resolve and extended-matching not applying to rule sets nested in a [Ruleset] section.
entries.zh: 修复了 no-resolve 和 extended-matching 未应用于嵌套在 [Ruleset] 部分中的规则集的问题。

entries.en: Fixed request notes listing sub-rules from an AND, OR or NOT branch that did not match.
entries.zh: 修复了请求说明中列出的、与 AND、OR 或 NOT 分支不匹配的子规则的问题。

entries.en: Fixed responses through Hysteria 2 policies sometimes missing their last part, most often HTTP/1.1 responses that end by closing the connection, on slow or lossy networks.
entries.zh: 修复了在缓慢或丢包的网络环境下，通过 Hysteria 2 策略组生成的响应有时会丢失最后部分的问题，这种情况最常出现在以关闭连接结尾的 HTTP/1.1 响应中。

entries.en: Fixed several MASQUE issues with Envoy:
entries.zh: 修复了 Envoy 中的几个 MASQUE 问题：

entries.en: Fixed the Configure page keeping the previous start switch style's header until relaunch.
entries.zh: 修复了“配置”页面在重新启动前仍保留先前启动切换器样式的标题的问题。

entries.en: Fixed the expanded policy group card's tiles and scroll indicator sticking out past its rounded corners.
entries.zh: 修复了展开后的策略组卡片中，磁贴和滚动指示器超出其圆角范围的问题。

entries.en: Fixed uploads through SSH policies getting corrupted after the session rekeyed, which happens after 1 GB.
entries.zh: 修复了通过 SSH 策略组上传的文件在会话重新加密后损坏的问题，该问题在传输量达到 1 GB 后发生。

entries.en: GET /v1/capture/sessions, /v1/capture/sessions/requests and /v1/capture/sessions/data
entries.zh: GET /v1/capture/sessions、/v1/capture/sessions/requests 和 /v1/capture/sessions/data

entries.en: Going forward, every change to Surge Engine will be validated through this platform to catch compatibility issues and other bugs early, prevent performance regressions, and maintain consistent reliability across updates.
entries.zh: 未来，对 Surge Engine 的每一次更改都将通过此平台进行验证，以便及早发现兼容性问题及其他错误，防止性能退化，并确保在每次更新后都能保持一致的可靠性。

entries.en: HTTP and HTTPS (407 or 401)
entries.zh: HTTP 和 HTTPS (407 或 401)

entries.en: HTTP proxy: the Proxy-Authorization header is no longer forwarded to the upstream server. It carries the credentials for Surge's own proxy.
entries.zh: HTTP 代理：Proxy-Authorization 标头将不再转发到上游服务器。它包含的是 Surge 自身代理的凭据。

entries.en: Hysteria 2
entries.zh: Hysteria 2

entries.en: Hysteria 2: UDP datagrams larger than the server allows are now always split into fragments, even when they have the Don't Fragment flag set. Since v2.6.4, official Hysteria 2 servers limit datagrams to about 1,200 bytes. Before, Surge rejected larger datagrams marked Don't Fragment, which broke Steam Datagram Relay (CS2 matchmaking failed) and QUIC connections inside the tunnel. Each datagram can now also carry about 45 more bytes.
entries.zh: Hysteria 2：现在，大于服务器允许大小的 UDP 数据报在发送时总会拆分成多个片段，即使它们设置了“不分片”（Don't Fragment）标志。由于 v2.6.4，官方的 Hysteria 2 服务器将数据报限制在约 1,200 字节。此前，Surge 会拒绝带有“不分片”标志的更大数据报，这会导致 Steam 数据报中继（CS2 匹配失败）以及隧道内的 QUIC 连接中断。现在，每个数据报还可以多承载约 45 字节的数据。

entries.en: If you rely on Surge being connected at all times, we recommend staying on iOS 27.2 until Apple releases a fix.
entries.zh: 如果您依赖 Surge 始终保持连接，我们建议您在 Apple 发布修复程序前，继续使用 iOS 27.2。

entries.en: In an era where AI has made writing code dramatically simpler, implementing a feature is rarely the hard part anymore. What hasn't gotten cheaper is everything that comes after: every protocol we add becomes a long-term commitment to maintain, secure, and support, and it shapes what Surge stands for. That's exactly why we've become more deliberate, not less, about what goes into Surge. Our hesitation around VLESS and REALITY was never about whether we could build them, but whether we should.
entries.zh: 在人工智能让编写代码变得前所未有的简单这个时代，实现一个功能早已不再是难事。但真正没有变得更便宜的，是随之而来的所有工作：我们每增加一个协议，就意味着承担了一项长期的维护、安全和支持承诺，而这也会塑造 Surge 的核心理念。正因如此，我们在决定将哪些内容纳入 Surge 时，反而变得更加审慎，而非更草率。我们曾对 VLESS 和 REALITY 犹豫不决，从来不是因为无法实现它们，而是因为不确定是否应该实现它们。

entries.en: In the meantime, the next Surge beta gives you clearer information when this happens. If Surge is stopped, you will receive a notification that states the exact reason, so you can tell a system-initiated stop apart from other issues.
entries.zh: 与此同时，下一版 Surge beta 将在出现这种情况时为您提供更清晰的信息。如果 Surge 被停止，您将收到一条通知，其中会说明确切原因，以便您能够区分系统发起的停止与其他问题。

entries.en: Known Issue: Surge May Stop Unexpectedly on iOS 27.3 Beta 1
entries.zh: 已知问题：Surge 在 iOS 上可能会意外停止 27.3 测试版 1

entries.en: MASQUE now sends 1,350-byte QUIC packets, so it cannot connect over paths whose MTU is below 1,378 (IPv4) or 1,398 (IPv6).
entries.zh: MASQUE 现在发送 1,350 字节的 QUIC 数据包，因此无法通过 MTU 低于 1,378（IPv4）或 1,398（IPv6）的路径进行连接。

entries.en: MCP Server
entries.zh: MCP 服务器

entries.en: MCP tools list_capture_sessions, list_capture_session_requests and get_capture_session_body
entries.zh: MCP 工具 list_capture_sessions、list_capture_session_requests 和 get_capture_session_body

entries.en: New `client-random-auth-key` parameter for TrustTunnel servers v1.3.0-beta.2 and later, which can accept only clients that prove they hold a shared key. It works in both HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 mode.
entries.zh: TrustTunnel 服务器新增 `client-random-auth-key` 参数（适用于 v1.3.0-beta.2 及更高版本），该参数仅接受能够证明其持有共享密钥的客户端。此功能在 HTTP/2 和 HTTP/3 模式下均可使用。

entries.en: New [MITM] server-certificates = <hostname>:<keystore item>, ... decrypts the listed hosts with your own certificate, such as a publicly trusted one, instead of one signed by Surge's CA. Use it to inspect apps that pin their certificate or reject user-installed CAs.
entries.zh: 新增 [MITM] server-certificates = <hostname>:<keystore item>, ... 功能，可使用您自己的证书（例如受公众信任的证书）来解密列出的主机，而不再使用 Surge 的 CA 签发的证书。此功能可用于检查那些固定了其证书或拒绝用户安装的 CA 的应用程序。

entries.en: New `vless` proxy type. It supports RAW or WebSocket transport, with no TLS, TLS or REALITY. It also supports the `xtls-rprx-vision` flow and the gRPC transport over TLS or REALITY.
entries.zh: 新增 `vless` 代理类型。它支持 RAW 或 WebSocket 传输，无 TLS、TLS 或 REALITY。它还支持 `xtls-rprx-vision` 流以及通过 TLS 或 REALITY 的 gRPC 传输。

entries.en: New log-file-size-limit option in [General] sets the maximum log file size in MB. You can also set it in General → Log. When it is not set, the old limits still apply: 200 MB on Mac and 50 MB on iOS.
entries.zh: [General] 中新增的 log-file-size-limit 选项用于设置日志文件的最大大小（单位：MB）。您也可以在 General → Log 中进行设置。如果未设置，则仍适用旧有限制：Mac 上为 200 MB，iOS 上为 50 MB。

entries.en: New surge-cli capture-filter command to read and change capture filters.
entries.zh: 新增 surge-cli capture-filter 命令，用于读取和更改捕获过滤器。

entries.en: New surge-cli dump traffic-stat-records <today|this-month|last-month> returns one period's traffic statistics, merged by host, policy and interface. The same data is available through MCP.
entries.zh: 新的 surge-cli dump traffic-stat-records <today|this-month|last-month> 命令会返回某一时间段的流量统计数据，数据已按主机、策略和接口进行合并。同样的数据也可通过 MCP 获取。

entries.en: New surge-cli policy-avoid list|add|remove|clear, the MCP tool set_policy_avoidance and the HTTP API GET / POST /v1/policies/avoided. policy-group now reports the avoided members of automatic groups.
entries.zh: 新增 surge-cli policy-avoid list|add|remove|clear 命令、MCP 工具 set_policy_avoidance 以及 HTTP API GET / POST /v1/policies/avoided。策略组现在会报告自动策略组的已规避成员。

entries.en: New surge-cli profile section command to read or replace a single profile section. With #!include, the change goes into the file that holds the section and other files stay untouched.
entries.zh: 新增 surge-cli 配置文件章节命令，用于读取或替换单个配置文件章节。使用 #!include 时，更改将应用于包含该章节的文件，而其他文件则保持不变。

entries.en: New “Disable UDP Fast Path” option in the gateway settings. When a device creates many UDP flows in a short time (for example, P2P downloads), Surge VM normally moves it to the UDP Fast Path. That path forwards its UDP traffic directly at L3 without applying rules. Turn this option on to stop using the fast path for all devices, so all UDP traffic always goes through your rules.
entries.zh: 网关设置中新增“禁用 UDP 快速路径”选项。当设备在短时间内创建大量 UDP 流时（例如 P2P 下载），Surge VM 通常会将这些流移至 UDP 快速路径。该路径会直接在 L3 层转发 UDP 流量，而不会应用任何规则。启用此选项后，所有设备都将不再使用快速路径，从而确保所有 UDP 流量始终经过您的规则。

entries.en: Note: Surge does not apply your Tailscale access control policy to incoming connections. Use rules such as SRC-IP to limit who can reach which destination.
entries.zh: 注意：Surge 不会将您的 Tailscale 访问控制策略应用于入站连接。请使用 SRC-IP 等规则来限制哪些人可以访问哪些目标。

entries.en: On iOS 27.3 beta 1, a problem in the system’s Network Extension framework can cause Surge to stop unexpectedly. The problem is in iOS itself, and we are waiting for Apple to fix it in a future update.
entries.zh: 在 iOS 27.3 测试版 1 中，系统的 Network Extension 框架存在一个问题，可能导致 Surge 意外停止。该问题源于 iOS 本身，我们正在等待 Apple 在后续更新中修复此问题。

entries.zh: 重新加载配置文件

entries.en: Profile errors now explain why a line is invalid, not only where it is.
entries.zh: 配置文件错误现在会说明某条线路无效的原因，而不仅仅是指出其位置。

entries.en: Special handling for Apple Screen Sharing is now built in and works without any configuration.
entries.zh: 现已内置对 Apple 屏幕共享的特殊处理，无需任何配置即可使用。

entries.en: Surge Mac 6.11.0 has now been officially released.
entries.zh: Surge Mac 6.11.0 现已正式发布。

entries.en: Surge VM
entries.zh: Surge VM

entries.en: Surge now sends a notification whenever iOS stops the VPN for any reason other than you stopping it. Before, it only did so when the VPN configuration was disabled.
entries.zh: 现在，只要 iOS 因任何非您主动停止的原因而中断 VPN，Surge 就会发送通知。此前，仅在 VPN 配置文件被禁用时才会发送通知。

entries.en: The HTTP API can now serve a Model Context Protocol endpoint at /v1/mcp, so AI agents such as Claude Code can inspect and control Surge. Enable it with the MCP Server switch in the HTTP API settings, or with http-api-mcp = true. It is off by default.
entries.zh: 现在，HTTP API 可以在 /v1/mcp 提供 Model Context Protocol 端点，因此像 Claude Code 这样的 AI 智能体可以检查和控制 Surge。您可以通过 HTTP API 设置中的 MCP Server 开关，或设置 http-api-mcp = true 来启用此功能。默认情况下，该功能处于关闭状态。

entries.en: The Home tab style None is back. With None there is no Home tab, and the Configure page's header starts and stops Surge.
entries.zh: “主页”选项卡的“无”样式已回归。选择“无”后，将不再显示“主页”选项卡，“配置”页面的页眉将用于启动和停止 Surge。

entries.en: The first packet to each new UDP destination was lost.
entries.zh: 每个新的 UDP 目的地址的第一个数据包都丢失了。

entries.en: The latest Surge beta adds support for the VLESS protocol, including connections secured with REALITY. Configuration is currently available through text-based profiles only; see [https://manual.nssurge.com/policies/vless.html](https://manual.nssurge.com/policies/vless.html) for syntax and supported options.
entries.zh: 最新的 Surge 测试版新增了对 VLESS 协议的支持，包括通过 REALITY 保护的安全连接。目前仅可通过基于文本的配置文件进行配置；有关语法和支持的选项，请参阅 [https://manual.nssurge.com/policies/vless.html](https://manual.nssurge.com/policies/vless.html)。

entries.en: The parameter requires an SNI, and it is masked in sanitized profiles.
entries.zh: 该参数需要一个 SNI，并且在清理后的配置文件中会被屏蔽。

entries.en: The proxy editor has a new field for TrustTunnel's client random auth key.
entries.zh: 代理编辑器新增了一个用于 TrustTunnel 客户端随机身份验证密钥的字段。

entries.en: Traffic statistics that were already stored as negative values (from the AnyTLS bug) are now shown as zero.
entries.zh: 原本以负值存储（源自 AnyTLS 漏洞）的流量统计数据现在将显示为 0。

entries.en: Traffic statistics: Tailscale MagicDNS hosts (*.[ts.net](http://ts.net/)) are now shown by their full hostname instead of all being grouped under [http://ts.net](http://ts.net/). The per-host report now adds up entries for the same host instead of keeping only one of them.
entries.zh: 流量统计：Tailscale MagicDNS 主机（*.[ts.net](http://ts.net/)）现在会以其完整主机名显示，而不会全部归组到 [http://ts.net](http://ts.net/) 下。现在，每个主机的报告会将相同主机的条目进行汇总，而不再是仅保留其中一条。
