entries.zh: Surge 测试版现已支持 VLESS 和 REALITY

entries.en: We have built a fully automated, AI-powered testing platform for Surge Engine. The platform continuously evaluates compatibility and performance against the latest official client implementations of all supported proxy protocols, helping ensure that Surge matches or exceeds their performance.
entries.zh: 我们为 Surge Engine 构建了一个完全自动化且由 AI 驱动的测试平台。该平台会持续评估 Surge Engine 在所有受支持的代理协议的最新官方客户端实现环境下的兼容性与性能，从而确保 Surge Engine 的性能能够与之匹配甚至超越。

entries.en: We have reservations about aspects of their technical design. At the same time, many of our users need these technologies, and we know some have turned to unofficial modified builds of Surge to access them, which carries real security risks. In the end, we decided that a supported, trustworthy implementation serves our users better than leaving them without one.
entries.zh: 我们对他们的技术设计的某些方面存有保留意见。同时，我们的许多用户需要这些技术，而且我们知道，有些用户已经转而使用 Surge 的非官方修改版本来获取这些技术，而这会带来切实的安全风险。最终，我们决定，提供一个受支持且值得信赖的实现方案，比让用户无此方案可用，更能服务于我们的用户。

entries.en: When a server closes the connection during setup, for example TrustTunnel with a wrong key, Surge now retries once and then fails, instead of retrying until the timeout.
entries.zh: 当服务器在设置期间关闭连接时（例如，TrustTunnel 的密钥错误），Surge 现在会重试一次然后失败，而不会一直重试直到超时。

entries.en: Why We're Adding VLESS and REALITY
entries.zh: 我们为何要添加 VLESS 和 REALITY

entries.en: WireGuard and Tailscale: changing [Proxy] or [Proxy Group] no longer restarts every WireGuard and Tailscale session. A session is kept when its policy line and its own section are unchanged, so connections through it keep working. Before, a change made over the tailnet, such as from surge-cli or MCP on another device, cut off its own reply.
entries.zh: WireGuard 和 Tailscale：更改 [Proxy] 或 [Proxy Group] 后，将不再重启每个 WireGuard 和 Tailscale 会话。如果某个会话的策略行及其自身部分均未更改，则该会话将得以保留，从而确保通过它的连接仍能正常工作。此前，通过 tailnet 进行的更改（例如来自另一台设备上的 surge-cli 或 MCP 的更改）会中断其自身的响应。

entries.en: Wrong credentials now fail right away instead of after the 10-second setup timeout. This covers:
entries.zh: 现在，错误的凭据会立即失败，而不会等到 10 秒的设置超时之后。这包括：

entries.en: You can now mark a policy as avoided. Use this when a policy passes latency tests but performs poorly in practice, for example with low bandwidth. Automatic groups (url-test, fallback, load-balance and smart) skip an avoided policy as long as any other member is usable. If nothing else is left, the avoided policy is still used.
entries.zh: 现在，您可以将某项策略标记为“已避免”。当某项策略通过了延迟测试但在实际使用中表现不佳（例如带宽较低）时，可使用此功能。只要其他成员可用，自动策略组（url-test、fallback、load-balance 和 smart）就会跳过“已避免”的策略。如果别无选择，系统仍会使用“已避免”的策略。

entries.en: advertise-exit-node = true: offer this device as an exit node. Other tailnet devices that select it send all their internet traffic through Surge's rules.
entries.zh: advertise-exit-node = true：将此设备提供为出口节点。选择该设备的其他 tailnet 设备会将其所有互联网流量通过 Surge 的规则发送。

entries.en: advertise-routes = [192.168.1.0/24](http://192.168.1.0/24), ...: offer this device as a subnet router for the listed networks.
entries.zh: advertise-routes = [192.168.1.0/24](http://192.168.1.0/24), ...: 将此设备作为所列网络的子网路由器提供。

entries.en: allow-peer-access = true: other devices on your tailnet can connect to this device through its tailnet address. For example, they can use Surge's HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy or other services running on this device. (The old parameter accept-incoming has been renamed, but it will still be read for compatibility.)
entries.zh: allow-peer-access = true：您 tailnet 网络中的其他设备可以通过该设备的 tailnet 地址连接到此设备。例如，它们可以使用 Surge 的 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理或运行在此设备上的其他服务。（旧参数 accept-incoming 已被重命名，但为了兼容仍会读取。）

entries.en: allow-peer-access = true: the peer side can open connections to this device through an existing tunnel.
entries.zh: allow-peer-access = true：对端可以通过现有隧道与此设备建立连接。

entries.en: an SSH host key that does not match `server-fingerprint` (the error names the key the server offered)
entries.zh: 不匹配 `server-fingerprint` 的 SSH 主机密钥（错误信息中会指明服务器提供的密钥名称）

entries.en: block-quic=auto now uses adaptive mode for every policy except DIRECT, so QUIC-only apps keep working through proxies. Policies that cannot relay UDP still block QUIC.
entries.zh: block-quic=auto 现在对除 DIRECT 外的所有策略都使用自适应模式，因此仅使用 QUIC 的应用仍可正常通过代理工作。无法转发 UDP 的策略仍会阻止 QUIC。

entries.en: listen-port = 51820: Surge acts as a WireGuard server that phones, laptops, and other clients can connect to. A peer can leave out endpoint; Surge learns the client's address when it connects and keeps up when the address changes.
entries.zh: listen-port = 51820：Surge 充当 WireGuard 服务器，手机、笔记本电脑和其他客户端都可以连接到该服务器。对等端可以省略端点；Surge 会在客户端连接时获知其地址，并在地址变更时保持同步。

entries.en: socks5-listen now supports username:password@ authentication, the same way as http-listen.
entries.zh: socks5-listen 现在支持与 http-listen 相同的 username:password@ 身份验证方式。

entries.en: surge-cli module list now shows details for each module: its type, version, file modification time, and the number of lines it adds to each section (or why it failed to load). New surge-cli module show <name> also shows every #! header field, the declared argument names and the module text. Also available through MCP (list_modules and the new get_module) and the HTTP API (GET /v1/modules and the new /v1/modules/detail).
entries.zh: surge-cli module list 现在会显示每个模块的详细信息：其类型、版本、文件修改时间，以及它为每个部分添加的行数（或显示其加载失败的原因）。新的 surge-cli module show <name> 命令还会显示每个 #! 标头字段、声明的参数名称以及模块文本。该功能也通过 MCP（list_modules 和新的 get_module）以及 HTTP API（GET /v1/modules 和新的 /v1/modules/detail）提供。

entries.en: surge-cli rule match and rule explain now show where the matched rule comes from: the profile file and line, or the module that added it. For a RULE-SET or DOMAIN-SET, they also show the entry inside the set that matched. The same fields are returned through MCP and the HTTP API.
entries.zh: surge-cli 的规则匹配和规则解释功能现在会显示匹配的规则来自何处：配置文件及其行号，或添加该规则的模块。对于 RULE-SET 或 DOMAIN-SET，它们还会显示规则集内部匹配的具体条目。相同的字段也会通过 MCP 和 HTTP API 返回。
